# Read benchmark input and previously completed comparator results
```{r}
benchmark_input <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "benchmark_input.qs"))
counts <- benchmark_input$counts
meta <- benchmark_input$metadata
gene_meta <- benchmark_input$gene_meta
sample_info <- benchmark_input$sample_info
count.mat <- benchmark_input$pseudobulk_counts
expr.mat <- benchmark_input$pseudobulk_expression
truth_cond1 <- benchmark_input$truth_cond1
truth_cond2 <- benchmark_input$truth_cond2
truth_long <- benchmark_input$truth_long
truth_total <- benchmark_input$truth_total
sig_truth <- truth_total$gene[truth_total$truth]

HR_cond1 <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "HarmonicRegression_cond1.qs"))
HR_cond2 <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "HarmonicRegression_cond2.qs"))
dry_res <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "dryR_full.qs"))
CC_cond1 <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "CircaCompare_cond1.qs"))
CC_cond2 <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "CircaCompare_cond2.qs"))
JTK_fit_cond1 <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "JTK_cond1.qs"))
JTK_fit_cond2 <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "JTK_cond2.qs"))

cat("Loaded benchmark input and saved comparator results.\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(counts), " Cells:", ncol(counts), " Samples:", nrow(sample_info), "\n")
```

# Reconstruct calls from the saved comparator-native results
```{r}
# HarmonicRegression: q-value < 0.05
sig_HR_cond1 <- if (!is.null(names(HR_cond1$qvals))) names(HR_cond1$qvals)[!is.na(HR_cond1$qvals) & HR_cond1$qvals < 0.05] else rownames(expr.mat)[!is.na(HR_cond1$qvals) & HR_cond1$qvals < 0.05]
sig_HR_cond2 <- if (!is.null(names(HR_cond2$qvals))) names(HR_cond2$qvals)[!is.na(HR_cond2$qvals) & HR_cond2$qvals < 0.05] else rownames(expr.mat)[!is.na(HR_cond2$qvals) & HR_cond2$qvals < 0.05]
sig_HR <- union(sig_HR_cond1, sig_HR_cond2)

# dryR: chosen-model BIC weight >= 0.95 and max Cook <= 1
dry_max_cook <- apply(dry_res$cook, 1, max, na.rm=TRUE)
sig_dryR_tab <- dry_res$results[dry_res$results$chosen_model_BICW >= 0.95 & dry_max_cook <= 1,,drop=FALSE]
sig_dryR_cond1 <- rownames(sig_dryR_tab)[!is.na(sig_dryR_tab$amp_cond_1)]
sig_dryR_cond2 <- rownames(sig_dryR_tab)[!is.na(sig_dryR_tab$amp_cond_2)]
sig_dryR <- union(sig_dryR_cond1, sig_dryR_cond2)

# CircaCompare: native rhythmic_p < 0.01
CC_p_cond1 <- sapply(CC_cond1, function(x) {if (inherits(x,"error")) return(NA_real_); x$summary$value[x$summary$parameter=="rhythmic_p"]})
CC_p_cond2 <- sapply(CC_cond2, function(x) {if (inherits(x,"error")) return(NA_real_); x$summary$value[x$summary$parameter=="rhythmic_p"]})
sig_CC_cond1 <- names(CC_p_cond1)[!is.na(CC_p_cond1) & CC_p_cond1 < 0.01]
sig_CC_cond2 <- names(CC_p_cond2)[!is.na(CC_p_cond2) & CC_p_cond2 < 0.01]
sig_CC <- union(sig_CC_cond1, sig_CC_cond2)

# JTK: native BH.Q < 0.05
JTK_cond1 <- JTK_fit_cond1$JTK
JTK_cond2 <- JTK_fit_cond2$JTK
JTK_q_cond1 <- as.numeric(JTK_cond1[,"BH.Q"])
JTK_q_cond2 <- as.numeric(JTK_cond2[,"BH.Q"])
sig_JTK_cond1 <- as.character(JTK_cond1[!is.na(JTK_q_cond1) & JTK_q_cond1 < 0.05,"CycID"])
sig_JTK_cond2 <- as.character(JTK_cond2[!is.na(JTK_q_cond2) & JTK_q_cond2 < 0.05,"CycID"])
sig_JTK <- union(sig_JTK_cond1, sig_JTK_cond2)

c(GroundTruth=length(sig_truth), CircaCompare=length(sig_CC), HarmonicRegression=length(sig_HR), dryR=length(sig_dryR), JTK=length(sig_JTK))
```

# Run final scRhythmBayes gene-level algorithm
```{r}
# TRUE: rerun the frozen final infer_gene_param(); FALSE: reuse the saved final SRB result.
rerun_srb <- TRUE
srb_final_file <- file.path(result_dir, "scRhythmBayes_full_final_v2.qs")

if (rerun_srb || !file.exists(srb_final_file)) {
  res_srb <- infer_gene_param(
    count=counts,
    metadata=meta,
    theta_pred=meta$theta_obs,
    r_cell=meta$p,
    strata_by="group",
    ZT_by="ZT_bin_num",
    sample_by="sample",
    sample_boot_by="ZT_bin",
    n_worker=4,
    setseed=1,
    Verbose=TRUE
  )
  qs::qsave(res_srb, srb_final_file)
} else {
  res_srb <- qs::qread(srb_final_file)
}

sig_srb_cond1 <- res_srb$param_long %>% dplyr::filter(group=="cond_1", FDR<0.05) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
sig_srb_cond2 <- res_srb$param_long %>% dplyr::filter(group=="cond_2", FDR<0.05) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
sig_srb <- union(sig_srb_cond1, sig_srb_cond2)

cat("Final scRhythmBayes calls:\n")
print(c(cond1=length(sig_srb_cond1), cond2=length(sig_srb_cond2), total=length(sig_srb)))
cat("\nEligibility by condition:\n")
print(table(res_srb$gene_eligibility$group, res_srb$gene_eligibility$eligible, useNA="ifany"))
cat("\nEB shrinkage metadata:\n")
print(res_srb$shrinkage$by_stratum)
```

# Prepare final benchmark tables
```{r}
HR_wide <- data.frame(
  gene=rownames(expr.mat),
  mean_cond1=HR_cond1$means, amp_cond1=HR_cond1$pars$amp, phi_cond1=HR_cond1$pars$phi, pval_cond1=HR_cond1$pvals, qval_cond1=HR_cond1$qvals,
  mean_cond2=HR_cond2$means, amp_cond2=HR_cond2$pars$amp, phi_cond2=HR_cond2$pars$phi, pval_cond2=HR_cond2$pvals, qval_cond2=HR_cond2$qvals,
  row.names=NULL
)

dryR_wide <- as.data.frame(dry_res$parameters)

SRB_wide <- res_srb$param_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group=dplyr::recode(group,"cond_1"="cond1","cond_2"="cond2")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols=gene,
    names_from=group,
    values_from=c(Mesor,Mean,Amplitude,Amplitude_shrunk,Phase,Alpha,Dropout_rate,P_value,FDR),
    names_glue="{.value}_{group}"
  )

CC_df <- function(CC, suffix) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(CC), function(gene) {
    obj <- CC[[gene]]
    if (inherits(obj,"error")) return(NULL)
    x <- obj$summary
    vals <- setNames(as.list(x$value), x$parameter)
    tibble::tibble(gene=gene, !!!vals)
  })) %>% dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x,"_",suffix), -gene)
}
CC_wide <- dplyr::full_join(CC_df(CC_cond1,"cond1"), CC_df(CC_cond2,"cond2"), by="gene")

JTK_cond1_wide <- JTK_cond1
colnames(JTK_cond1_wide)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(JTK_cond1_wide)[-1],"_cond1")
JTK_cond2_wide <- JTK_cond2
colnames(JTK_cond2_wide)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(JTK_cond2_wide)[-1],"_cond2")
JTK_wide <- dplyr::full_join(JTK_cond1_wide,JTK_cond2_wide,by="CycID") %>% dplyr::rename(gene=CycID)

genes <- as.character(gene_meta$gene)
rhythmic.df <- data.frame(
  GT=genes %in% sig_truth,
  scRhythmBayes=genes %in% sig_srb,
  CircaCompare=genes %in% sig_CC,
  HarmonicRegression=genes %in% sig_HR,
  dryR=genes %in% sig_dryR,
  JTK=genes %in% sig_JTK,
  row.names=genes
)

sig_gene_counts <- tibble::tibble(
  Method=c("GroundTruth","scRhythmBayes","CircaCompare","HarmonicRegression","dryR","JTK"),
  Cond1=c(sum(truth_cond1$A_truth>0),length(sig_srb_cond1),length(sig_CC_cond1),length(sig_HR_cond1),length(sig_dryR_cond1),length(sig_JTK_cond1)),
  Cond2=c(sum(truth_cond2$A_truth>0),length(sig_srb_cond2),length(sig_CC_cond2),length(sig_HR_cond2),length(sig_dryR_cond2),length(sig_JTK_cond2)),
  Total=c(length(sig_truth),length(sig_srb),length(sig_CC),length(sig_HR),length(sig_dryR),length(sig_JTK))
)
print(sig_gene_counts)
readr::write_tsv(sig_gene_counts, file.path(result_dir,"rhythmic_gene_counts_final_v2.tsv"))

prepared_results <- list(
  HR_wide=HR_wide, dryR_wide=dryR_wide, SRB_wide=SRB_wide, CC_wide=CC_wide, JTK_wide=JTK_wide,
  rhythmic_df=rhythmic.df,
  sig_truth=sig_truth,
  sig_srb_cond1=sig_srb_cond1, sig_srb_cond2=sig_srb_cond2, sig_srb=sig_srb,
  sig_CC_cond1=sig_CC_cond1, sig_CC_cond2=sig_CC_cond2, sig_CC=sig_CC,
  sig_HR_cond1=sig_HR_cond1, sig_HR_cond2=sig_HR_cond2, sig_HR=sig_HR,
  sig_dryR_cond1=sig_dryR_cond1, sig_dryR_cond2=sig_dryR_cond2, sig_dryR=sig_dryR,
  sig_JTK_cond1=sig_JTK_cond1, sig_JTK_cond2=sig_JTK_cond2, sig_JTK=sig_JTK,
  srb_gene_eligibility=res_srb$gene_eligibility,
  srb_shrinkage=res_srb$shrinkage,
  srb_inference=res_srb$inference
)
qs::qsave(prepared_results, file.path(result_dir,"prepared_benchmark_results_final_v2.qs"))
```

# Part 2. Original ROC workflow

#ROC 
##calculate 
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(pROC)
  library(readr)
})


## 1. Output

out_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output/ROC_TOTAL/"

dir.create(
  out_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


## 2. Gene universe


all_genes <- rownames(rhythmic.df)


## 3. scRhythmBayes
## Total rhythmicity = cond1 OR cond2


SRB_score <- SRB_wide %>%
  transmute(
    gene,
    score_cond1 = ifelse(is.finite(FDR_cond1), -log10(pmax(FDR_cond1, 1e-300)), 0),
    score_cond2 = ifelse(is.finite(FDR_cond2), -log10(pmax(FDR_cond2, 1e-300)), 0),
    scRhythmBayes = pmax(score_cond1, score_cond2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, scRhythmBayes)


## 4. CircaCompare


CC_score <- CC_wide %>%
  transmute(
    gene,
    CircaCompare = pmax(
      -log10(pmax(rhythmic_p_cond1, 1e-300)),
      -log10(pmax(rhythmic_p_cond2, 1e-300)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


## 5. Harmonic Regression


HR_score <- HR_wide %>%
  transmute(
    gene,
    HarmonicRegression = pmax(
      -log10(pmax(qval_cond1, 1e-300)),
      -log10(pmax(qval_cond2, 1e-300)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


## 6. JTK


JTK_score <- JTK_wide %>%
  transmute(
    gene,
    JTK = pmax(
      -log10(pmax(BH.Q_cond1, 1e-300)),
      -log10(pmax(BH.Q_cond2, 1e-300)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


## 7. dryR
##
## Model 1   = non-rhythmic in both conditions
## Model 2-5 = rhythmic in at least one condition
##
## Total rhythmic evidence = sum of BICW for models 2-5
##                         = 1 - BICW(model 1)

dryR_score <- tibble(
  gene = rownames(dryR_wide),
  dryR = rowSums(
    dry_res$BICW_rhythm[, 2:5, drop = FALSE]
  )
)


## 8. Merge all scores


roc_score_total <- tibble(
  gene = all_genes
) %>%
  left_join(
    SRB_score,
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    CC_score,
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    HR_score,
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    dryR_score,
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    JTK_score,
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(
      ifelse(
        rhythmic.df[gene, "GT", drop = TRUE],
        "Rhythmic",
        "Non-rhythmic"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Non-rhythmic",
        "Rhythmic"
      )
    )
  )


## 9. Check


print(dim(roc_score_total))

print(
  table(
    roc_score_total$truth
  )
)

print(
  roc_score_total %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        c(
          scRhythmBayes,
          CircaCompare,
          HarmonicRegression,
          dryR,
          JTK
        ),
        ~ sum(is.na(.x))
      )
    )
)

print(
  summary(
    roc_score_total[
      c(
        "scRhythmBayes",
        "CircaCompare",
        "HarmonicRegression",
        "dryR",
        "JTK"
      )
    ]
  )
)


## 10. ROC function


make_roc <- function(score) {

  keep <- !is.na(score) &
    !is.na(roc_score_total$truth)

  pROC::roc(
    response = roc_score_total$truth[keep],
    predictor = score[keep],
    levels = c(
      "Non-rhythmic",
      "Rhythmic"
    ),
    direction = "<",
    quiet = TRUE
  )
}


## 11. Calculate ROC


roc_scrhythm <- make_roc(
  roc_score_total$scRhythmBayes
)

roc_cica <- make_roc(
  roc_score_total$CircaCompare
)

roc_harm <- make_roc(
  roc_score_total$HarmonicRegression
)

roc_dryR <- make_roc(
  roc_score_total$dryR
)

roc_jtk <- make_roc(
  roc_score_total$JTK
)


## 12. ROC plotting dataframe


make_roc_df <- function(
    roc_obj,
    method_name
) {

  tibble(
    FPR = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    TPR = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    Method = method_name
  )
}

roc_plot_df <- bind_rows(
  make_roc_df(
    roc_scrhythm,
    "scRhythmBayes"
  ),
  make_roc_df(
    roc_cica,
    "CircaCompare"
  ),
  make_roc_df(
    roc_harm,
    "HarmonicRegression"
  ),
  make_roc_df(
    roc_dryR,
    "dryR"
  ),
  make_roc_df(
    roc_jtk,
    "JTK"
  )
)


## 13. AUC


auc_df <- tibble(
  Method = c(
    "scRhythmBayes",
    "CircaCompare",
    "HarmonicRegression",
    "dryR",
    "JTK"
  ),

  AUC = c(
    as.numeric(
      pROC::auc(roc_scrhythm)
    ),
    as.numeric(
      pROC::auc(roc_cica)
    ),
    as.numeric(
      pROC::auc(roc_harm)
    ),
    as.numeric(
      pROC::auc(roc_dryR)
    ),
    as.numeric(
      pROC::auc(roc_jtk)
    )
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    legend_label = paste0(
      Method,
      " (AUC=",
      sprintf(
        "%.3f",
        AUC
      ),
      ")"
    )
  )

print(auc_df)


## 14. Save calculation results


write_tsv(
  auc_df,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "ROC_total_AUC.tsv"
  )
)

write_tsv(
  roc_score_total,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "ROC_total_scores.tsv"
  )
)

write_tsv(
  roc_plot_df,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "ROC_total_curve.tsv"
  )
)
```

##plot
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)
})


## 1. Colors


ALG_COLORS <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes"      = "#C8D5B9",
  "CircaCompare"       = "#CDDCE5",
  "HarmonicRegression" = "#FAF3DD",
  "dryR"               = "#F8DDDA",
  "JTK"                = "#E1D7D0"
)

method_order <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes",
  "CircaCompare",
  "HarmonicRegression",
  "dryR",
  "JTK"
)


## 2. Factor order


roc_plot_df$Method <- factor(
  roc_plot_df$Method,
  levels = method_order
)

auc_df$Method <- factor(
  auc_df$Method,
  levels = method_order
)

legend_labels <- setNames(
  auc_df$legend_label,
  as.character(auc_df$Method)
)


## 3. ROC plot


p_roc <- ggplot(
  roc_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = FPR,
    y = TPR,
    color = Method
  )
) +

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey60",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +

  coord_equal() +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = ALG_COLORS,
    breaks = method_order,
    labels = legend_labels[method_order]
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "ROC Curve by All Algorithms",
    x = "False Positive Rate",
    y = "True Positive Rate",
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_figure3() +
```

# Part 3. Original parameter-recovery workflows

#MESOR
##MAE/RSME/R2
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)


## 1. Ground truth


GT <- gene_meta %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    GT = M
  )



## 2. SRB


SRB_eval <- SRB_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    Mesor_cond1,
    Mesor_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Mesor_cond1, Mesor_cond2),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      Mesor_cond1 = "cond1",
      Mesor_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Algorithm = "scRhythmBayes"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(GT, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = Estimate_raw
  )



## 3. dryR


dryR_eval <- dryR_wide %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    mean_cond_1,
    mean_cond_2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_cond_1, mean_cond_2),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      mean_cond_1 = "cond1",
      mean_cond_2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Algorithm = "dryR"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(GT, by = "gene")



## 4. HarmonicRegression


HR_eval <- HR_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    mean_cond1,
    mean_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_cond1, mean_cond2),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      mean_cond1 = "cond1",
      mean_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Algorithm = "HarmonicRegression"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(GT, by = "gene")



## 5. CircaCompare


CC_eval <- CC_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    mesor_cond1,
    mesor_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mesor_cond1, mesor_cond2),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      mesor_cond1 = "cond1",
      mesor_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Algorithm = "CircaCompare"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(GT, by = "gene")



## 6. Condition-specific 10-fold CV calibration


cv_calibrate <- function(df, K = 10, seed = 202606) {

  set.seed(seed)

  genes <- unique(df$gene)

  fold_df <- data.frame(
    gene = genes,
    fold = sample(
      rep(
        1:K,
        length.out = length(genes)
      )
    )
  )

  df <- df %>%
    left_join(
      fold_df,
      by = "gene"
    )

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      unique(df$Condition),
      function(cond) {

        dat <- df %>%
          filter(
            Condition == cond
          )

        bind_rows(
          lapply(
            1:K,
            function(k) {

              train <- dat %>%
                filter(
                  fold != k,
                  is.finite(Estimate_raw),
                  is.finite(GT)
                )

              test <- dat %>%
                filter(
                  fold == k,
                  is.finite(Estimate_raw),
                  is.finite(GT)
                )

              fit <- lm(
                GT ~ Estimate_raw,
                data = train
              )

              test$Estimate <- predict(
                fit,
                newdata = test
              )

              test
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
}



## 7. Calibrate dryR / HR / CC


dryR_eval <- cv_calibrate(
  dryR_eval
)

HR_eval <- cv_calibrate(
  HR_eval
)

CC_eval <- cv_calibrate(
  CC_eval
)



## 8. Combine


mesor_eval <- bind_rows(
  SRB_eval,
  dryR_eval,
  HR_eval,
  CC_eval
) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(Estimate),
    is.finite(GT)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Error = Estimate - GT,
    Absolute_Error = abs(Error),
    Squared_Error = Error^2
  )



## 9. Metrics by condition


mesor_metric_condition <- mesor_eval %>%
  group_by(
    Algorithm,
    Condition
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),

    MAE = mean(
      Absolute_Error
    ),

    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean(Squared_Error)
    ),

    R2 = 1 - sum((Estimate - GT)^2) / sum((GT - mean(GT))^2),

    Bias = mean(
      Error
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )



## 10. Overall metrics


mesor_metric_total <- mesor_eval %>%
  group_by(
    Algorithm
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),

    MAE = mean(
      Absolute_Error
    ),

    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean(Squared_Error)
    ),

    R2 = 1 - sum((Estimate - GT)^2) / sum((GT - mean(GT))^2),

    Bias = mean(
      Error
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )



## 11. Algorithm order


algorithm_order <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes",
  "dryR",
  "HarmonicRegression",
  "CircaCompare"
)

mesor_metric_condition$Algorithm <- factor(
  mesor_metric_condition$Algorithm,
  levels = algorithm_order
)

mesor_metric_total$Algorithm <- factor(
  mesor_metric_total$Algorithm,
  levels = algorithm_order
)



## 12. Results


print(mesor_metric_condition)

print(mesor_metric_total)
```

##MAE/RSME/R2
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)


## 1. Ground truth


AMP_GT <- gene_meta %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    GT_cond1 = A_cond_1,
    GT_cond2 = A_cond_2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      GT_cond1,
      GT_cond2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "GT"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      GT_cond1 = "cond1",
      GT_cond2 = "cond2"
    )
  )



## 2. scRhythmBayes
## single amplitude: no conversion


SRB_amp_eval <- SRB_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    Amplitude_cond1,
    Amplitude_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Amplitude_cond1,
      Amplitude_cond2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      Amplitude_cond1 = "cond1",
      Amplitude_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Algorithm = "scRhythmBayes",
    Estimate = Estimate_raw
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    AMP_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 3. dryR
## dryR amp = peak-to-trough = 2 * single amplitude
## divide by 2 first


dryR_amp_eval <- dryR_wide %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    amp_cond_1,
    amp_cond_2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      amp_cond_1,
      amp_cond_2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      amp_cond_1 = "cond1",
      amp_cond_2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Estimate_raw = Estimate_raw * log(2) / 2,
    Algorithm = "dryR"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    AMP_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 4. HarmonicRegression


HR_amp_eval <- HR_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    amp_cond1,
    amp_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      amp_cond1,
      amp_cond2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      amp_cond1 = "cond1",
      amp_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Algorithm = "HarmonicRegression"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    AMP_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 5. CircaCompare


CC_amp_eval <- CC_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    amplitude_cond1,
    amplitude_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      amplitude_cond1,
      amplitude_cond2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      amplitude_cond1 = "cond1",
      amplitude_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Algorithm = "CircaCompare"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    AMP_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 6. Condition-specific 10-fold CV calibration


cv_calibrate_amp <- function(
    df,
    K = 10,
    seed = 202606
) {

  set.seed(seed)

  genes <- unique(df$gene)

  fold_df <- data.frame(
    gene = genes,
    fold = sample(
      rep(
        1:K,
        length.out = length(genes)
      )
    )
  )

  df <- df %>%
    left_join(
      fold_df,
      by = "gene"
    )

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      unique(df$Condition),
      function(cond) {

        dat <- df %>%
          filter(
            Condition == cond
          )

        bind_rows(
          lapply(
            1:K,
            function(k) {

              train <- dat %>%
                filter(
                  fold != k,
                  is.finite(Estimate_raw),
                  is.finite(GT)
                )

              test <- dat %>%
                filter(
                  fold == k,
                  is.finite(Estimate_raw),
                  is.finite(GT)
                )

              fit <- lm(
                GT ~ Estimate_raw,
                data = train
              )

              test$Estimate <- predict(
                fit,
                newdata = test
              )

              test$Estimate <- pmax(
                0,
                test$Estimate
              )

              test
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
}



## 7. Calibrate dryR / HR / CircaCompare


dryR_amp_eval <- cv_calibrate_amp(
  dryR_amp_eval
)

HR_amp_eval <- cv_calibrate_amp(
  HR_amp_eval
)

CC_amp_eval <- cv_calibrate_amp(
  CC_amp_eval
)



## 8. Combine


amplitude_eval <- bind_rows(

  )

    ),

    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )



## 10. Overall metrics

  group_by(
    Algorithm
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),

    MAE = mean(
      Absolute_Error
    ),

    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean(Squared_Error)
    ),

    R2 = 1 - sum((Estimate - GT)^2) / sum((GT - mean(GT))^2),

    Bias = mean(
      Error
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )



## 11. Algorithm order

  "scRhythmBayes",
  "CircaCompare",
  "HarmonicRegression",
  "dryR"
)

amplitude_metric_condition$Algorithm <- factor(
  amplitude_metric_condition$Algorithm,
```

```{r}
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      amplitude_cond1 = "cond1",
      amplitude_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Algorithm = "CircaCompare"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    AMP_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 6. JTK_CYCLE
## MetaCycle already applies sqrt(2) amplitude correction
## Do NOT multiply AMP by sqrt(2) again


JTK_amp_eval <- JTK_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    AMP_cond1,
    AMP_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      AMP_cond1,
      AMP_cond2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      AMP_cond1 = "cond1",
      AMP_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),
    Algorithm = "JTK"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    AMP_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 7. Condition-specific 10-fold CV calibration


cv_calibrate_amp <- function(
    df,
    K = 10,
    seed = 202606
) {

  set.seed(seed)

  genes <- unique(df$gene)

  fold_df <- data.frame(
    gene = genes,
    fold = sample(
      rep(
        1:K,
        length.out = length(genes)
      )
    )
  )

  df <- df %>%
    left_join(
      fold_df,
      by = "gene"
    )

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      unique(df$Condition),
      function(cond) {

        dat <- df %>%
          filter(
            Condition == cond
          )

        bind_rows(
          lapply(
            1:K,
            function(k) {

              train <- dat %>%
                filter(
                  fold != k,
                  is.finite(Estimate_raw),
                  is.finite(GT)
                )

              test <- dat %>%
                filter(
                  fold == k,
                  is.finite(Estimate_raw),
                  is.finite(GT)
                )

              fit <- lm(
                GT ~ Estimate_raw,
                data = train
              )

              test$Estimate <- predict(
                fit,
                newdata = test
              )

              test$Estimate <- pmax(
                0,
                test$Estimate
              )

              test
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
}



## 8. Scale calibration
##
## SRB:
## direct comparison because simulator and SRB use the
## same latent cosine-amplitude parameterization.
##
## dryR / HR / CircaCompare / JTK:
## map method-specific expression scales to simulator scale
## using condition-specific out-of-fold calibration.


dryR_amp_eval <- cv_calibrate_amp(
  dryR_amp_eval
)

HR_amp_eval <- cv_calibrate_amp(
  HR_amp_eval
)

CC_amp_eval <- cv_calibrate_amp(
  CC_amp_eval
)

JTK_amp_eval <- cv_calibrate_amp(
  JTK_amp_eval
)



## 9. Combine all algorithms


amplitude_eval <- bind_rows(
  SRB_amp_eval,
  CC_amp_eval,
  HR_amp_eval,
  dryR_amp_eval,
  JTK_amp_eval
) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(Estimate),
    is.finite(GT)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Error = Estimate - GT,
    Absolute_Error = abs(Error),
    Squared_Error = Error^2
  )



## 10. Algorithm order


algorithm_order <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes",
  "CircaCompare",
  "HarmonicRegression",
  "dryR",
  "JTK"
)

amplitude_eval$Algorithm <- factor(
  amplitude_eval$Algorithm,
  levels = algorithm_order
)



## 11. Metrics by condition


amplitude_metric_condition <- amplitude_eval %>%
  group_by(
    Algorithm,
    Condition
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),

    MAE = mean(
      Absolute_Error
    ),

    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean(Squared_Error)
    ),

    R2 = 1 - sum((Estimate - GT)^2) / sum((GT - mean(GT))^2),

    Bias = mean(
      Error
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )



## 12. Overall metrics


amplitude_metric_total <- amplitude_eval %>%
  group_by(
    Algorithm
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),

    MAE = mean(
      Absolute_Error
    ),

    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean(Squared_Error)
    ),

    R2 = 1 - sum((Estimate - GT)^2) / sum((GT - mean(GT))^2),

    Bias = mean(
      Error
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )



## 13. Results


print(
  amplitude_metric_condition
)

print(
  amplitude_metric_total
)
```

#Phase
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)


## 1. Circular functions


wrap24 <- function(x) {
  x %% 24
}

circular_diff_hour <- function(est, truth) {
  abs(((est - truth + 12) %% 24) - 12)
}

circular_mean_rad <- function(x) {
  atan2(
    mean(sin(x)),
    mean(cos(x))
  )
}

circular_cor_js <- function(est_hour, truth_hour) {

  x <- 2 * pi * est_hour / 24
  y <- 2 * pi * truth_hour / 24

  mx <- circular_mean_rad(x)
  my <- circular_mean_rad(y)

  num <- sum(
    sin(x - mx) *
      sin(y - my)
  )

  den <- sqrt(
    sum(sin(x - mx)^2) *
      sum(sin(y - my)^2)
  )

  if (!is.finite(den) || den == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  num / den
}



## 2. Ground truth
##
## Simulator:
## M + A*cos(theta - phi)
##
## phi: radians
## Convert to peak phase in hours
##
## Only evaluate truly rhythmic gene-condition pairs


PHASE_GT <- gene_meta %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),

    phase_cond1 =
      (phi_cond_1 %% (2 * pi)) *
      24 / (2 * pi),

    phase_cond2 =
      (phi_cond_2 %% (2 * pi)) *
      24 / (2 * pi),

    amp_cond1 = A_cond_1,
    amp_cond2 = A_cond_2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = c(".value", "Condition"),
    names_pattern = "(phase|amp)_(cond1|cond2)"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    GT_phase = phase,
    GT_amp = amp
  ) %>%
  filter(
    GT_amp > 0
  )



## 3. scRhythmBayes
##
## Phase_cond*: radians


SRB_phase_eval <- SRB_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    Phase_cond1,
    Phase_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Phase_cond1,
      Phase_cond2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Phase_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      Phase_cond1 = "cond1",
      Phase_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),

    Estimate = wrap24(
      Phase_raw * 24 / (2 * pi)
    ),

    Algorithm = "scRhythmBayes"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    Condition,
    Algorithm,
    Estimate
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    PHASE_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 4. CircaCompare
##
## peak_time_hours_cond*: already peak time in hours


CC_phase_eval <- CC_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    peak_time_hours_cond1,
    peak_time_hours_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      peak_time_hours_cond1,
      peak_time_hours_cond2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      peak_time_hours_cond1 = "cond1",
      peak_time_hours_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),

    Estimate = wrap24(
      Estimate
    ),

    Algorithm = "CircaCompare"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    Condition,
    Algorithm,
    Estimate
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    PHASE_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 5. HarmonicRegression
##
## Confirmed:
## phi = atan2(b.sin, a.cos) %% (2*pi)
##
## Therefore phi has exactly the same phase convention
## as the simulator.


HR_phase_eval <- HR_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    phi_cond1,
    phi_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      phi_cond1,
      phi_cond2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Phase_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      phi_cond1 = "cond1",
      phi_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),

    Estimate = wrap24(
      Phase_raw * 24 / (2 * pi)
    ),

    Algorithm = "HarmonicRegression"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    Condition,
    Algorithm,
    Estimate
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    PHASE_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 6. dryR
##
## phase_cond_* already in hours:
##
## period/(2*pi) * atan2(b,a) %% period


dryR_phase_eval <- dryR_wide %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "gene"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    phase_cond_1,
    phase_cond_2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      phase_cond_1,
      phase_cond_2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      phase_cond_1 = "cond1",
      phase_cond_2 = "cond2"
    ),

    Estimate = wrap24(
      Estimate
    ),

    Algorithm = "dryR"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    Condition,
    Algorithm,
    Estimate
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    PHASE_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 7. JTK_CYCLE
##
## LAG_cond*: estimated peak phase in hours


JTK_phase_eval <- JTK_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    LAG_cond1,
    LAG_cond2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      LAG_cond1,
      LAG_cond2
    ),
    names_to = "Condition",
    values_to = "Estimate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      Condition,
      LAG_cond1 = "cond1",
      LAG_cond2 = "cond2"
    ),

    Estimate = wrap24(
      Estimate
    ),

    Algorithm = "JTK"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    Condition,
    Algorithm,
    Estimate
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    PHASE_GT,
    by = c(
      "gene",
      "Condition"
    )
  )



## 8. Combine all algorithms


phase_eval <- bind_rows(
  SRB_phase_eval,
  CC_phase_eval,
  HR_phase_eval,
  dryR_phase_eval,
  JTK_phase_eval
) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(Estimate),
    is.finite(GT_phase)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = wrap24(
      Estimate
    ),

    GT_phase = wrap24(
      GT_phase
    ),

    Circular_Error = circular_diff_hour(
      Estimate,
      GT_phase
    ),

    Squared_Circular_Error =
      Circular_Error^2
  )



## 9. Algorithm order


phase_eval$Algorithm <- factor(
  phase_eval$Algorithm,
  levels = c(
    "scRhythmBayes",
    "CircaCompare",
    "HarmonicRegression",
    "dryR",
    "JTK"
  )
)



## 10. Phase metrics by condition


phase_metric_condition <- phase_eval %>%
  group_by(
    Algorithm,
    Condition
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),

    MAE = mean(
      Circular_Error
    ),

    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean(
        Squared_Circular_Error
      )
    ),

    Circular_R = circular_cor_js(
      Estimate,
      GT_phase
    ),

    R2 = Circular_R^2,

    .groups = "drop"
  )



## 11. Overall phase metrics


phase_metric_total <- phase_eval %>%
  group_by(
    Algorithm
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),

    MAE = mean(
      Circular_Error
    ),

    RMSE = sqrt(
      mean(
        Squared_Circular_Error
      )
    ),

    Circular_R = circular_cor_js(
      Estimate,
      GT_phase
    ),

    R2 = Circular_R^2,

    .groups = "drop"
  )



## 12. Results


print(
  phase_metric_condition
)

print(
  phase_metric_total
)
```

##cm plot
```{r}
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

############################################################
## 1. Output directory
############################################################

out_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output/confusion_matrix/"

dir.create(
  out_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

############################################################
## 2. Colors
############################################################

ALG_COLORS <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes"      = "#C8D5B9",
  "CircaCompare"       = "#CDDCE5",
  "HarmonicRegression" = "#FAF3DD",
  "dryR"               = "#F8DDDA",
  "JTK"                = "#E1D7D0",
  "Ground Truth"       = "#B1B0B2"
)

############################################################
## 3. Confusion matrix function
############################################################

make_confusion_plot <- function(
    truth,
    prediction,
    method_name,
    out_dir,
    color
) {

  truth_label <- ifelse(
    truth,
    "Rhythmic",
    "Non-rhythmic"
  )

  pred_label <- ifelse(
    prediction,
    "Rhythmic",
    "Non-rhythmic"
  )

  confm <- caret::confusionMatrix(
    data = factor(
      pred_label,
      levels = c("Rhythmic", "Non-rhythmic")
    ),
    reference = factor(
      truth_label,
      levels = c("Rhythmic", "Non-rhythmic")
    ),
    mode = "everything",
    positive = "Rhythmic"
  )

  print(confm)

  cm_df <- as.data.frame(confm$table) %>%
    mutate(
      Prediction = factor(
        Prediction,
        levels = c("Rhythmic", "Non-rhythmic")
      ),
      Reference = factor(
        Reference,
        levels = c("Rhythmic", "Non-rhythmic")
      ),
      Label_colour = "#151515"
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    cm_df,
    aes(
      x = Reference,
      y = Prediction,
      fill = Freq
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile(
      color = "#666666",
      linewidth = 0.9,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = Freq,
        colour = Label_colour
      ),
      size = 9,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#FFFFFF",
      high = color
    ) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    theme_figure3_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = method_name,
      x = "Truth",
      y = "Prediction"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        colour = "black",
        size=28
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size=22,
        colour = "black"
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size=20,
        colour = "black"
      ),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0("CM_", method_name, ".png")
    ),
    p,
    width = 8.5,
    height = 7.5,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0("CM_", method_name, ".pdf")
    ),
    p,
    width = 8.5,
    height = 7.5,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )

  write.csv(
    as.data.frame(confm$table),
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0("CM_", method_name, ".csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  metric_df <- tibble(
    Method = method_name,

    TP = as.numeric(
      confm$table["Rhythmic", "Rhythmic"]
    ),

    FP = as.numeric(
      confm$table["Rhythmic", "Non-rhythmic"]
    ),

    FN = as.numeric(
      confm$table["Non-rhythmic", "Rhythmic"]
    ),

    TN = as.numeric(
      confm$table["Non-rhythmic", "Non-rhythmic"]
    ),

    Accuracy = as.numeric(
      confm$overall["Accuracy"]
    ),

    Kappa = as.numeric(
      confm$overall["Kappa"]
    ),

    Sensitivity = as.numeric(
      confm$byClass["Sensitivity"]
    ),

    Specificity = as.numeric(
      confm$byClass["Specificity"]
    ),

    Precision = as.numeric(
      confm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
    ),

    Recall = as.numeric(
      confm$byClass["Sensitivity"]
    ),

    F1 = as.numeric(
      confm$byClass["F1"]
    )
  )

  write_tsv(
    metric_df,
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0("CM_", method_name, "_metrics.tsv")
    )
  )

  return(metric_df)
}

############################################################
## 4. dryR
############################################################

cm_dryR <- make_confusion_plot(
  truth = rhythmic.df$GT,
  prediction = rhythmic.df$dryR,
  method_name = "dryR",
  out_dir = out_dir,
  color = ALG_COLORS[["dryR"]]
)

############################################################
## 5. CircaCompare
############################################################

  truth = rhythmic.df$GT,
  prediction = rhythmic.df$CircaCompare,
  method_name = "CircaCompare",
  out_dir = out_dir,
  color = ALG_COLORS[["CircaCompare"]]
)

############################################################
## 6. HarmonicRegression
############################################################

  truth = rhythmic.df$GT,
  prediction = rhythmic.df$HarmonicRegression,
  method_name = "HarmonicRegression",
  out_dir = out_dir,
  color = ALG_COLORS[["HarmonicRegression"]]
)

############################################################
## 7. JTK
############################################################

cm_JTK <- make_confusion_plot(
  truth = rhythmic.df$GT,
  prediction = rhythmic.df$JTK,
  method_name = "JTK",
  out_dir = out_dir,
  color = ALG_COLORS[["JTK"]]

############################################################
## 8. scRhythmBayes
############################################################

cm_SRB <- make_confusion_plot(
  truth = rhythmic.df$GT,
  prediction = rhythmic.df$scRhythmBayes,
  method_name = "scRhythmBayes",
  out_dir = out_dir,
  color = ALG_COLORS[["scRhythmBayes"]]
)

############################################################
## 9. Combined metrics
############################################################

cm_metrics <- bind_rows(
  cm_SRB,
  cm_cica,
  cm_HR,
  cm_dryR,
  cm_JTK
)

write_tsv(
  cm_metrics,
  file.path(
    out_dir,

  )
)
```

```{r}
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

############################################################
## 1. Output directory
############################################################

venn_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output/VENN/"

dir.create(
  venn_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

############################################################
## 2. Gene sets
############################################################

venn_list <- list(
  SRB = rownames(rhythmic.df)[rhythmic.df$scRhythmBayes],
  CircaCompare = rownames(rhythmic.df)[rhythmic.df$CircaCompare],
  HR = rownames(rhythmic.df)[rhythmic.df$HarmonicRegression],
  dryR = rownames(rhythmic.df)[rhythmic.df$dryR],
  JTK = rownames(rhythmic.df)[rhythmic.df$JTK]
)

sapply(
  venn_list,
  length
)

############################################################
## 3. Venn diagram
############################################################

p_venn <- ggVennDiagram(
  venn_list,
  category.names = names(venn_list),
  label = "count",
  label_alpha = 0,
  edge_size = 0.8,
  set_size = 11.5,
  label_size = 8.5,
  edge_lty = "dashed",
  set_color = "black"
) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "#FAF3DD",
      "#F8DDDA",
      "#E1D7D0",
      "#CDDCE5",
      "#C8D5B9",
      "#AAB99B",
      "#899C80",
      "#687A60",
      "#465641"
    ),
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(
      base = 10,
      sigma = 2
    ),
    breaks = c(
      0,
      5,
      10,
      20,
      50,
      100,
      250,
      500,
      1000
    ),
    name = "Count",
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      barwidth = 1.2,
      barheight = 10
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Significant Rhythmic Genes"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      colour = "#20242A"
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size=28
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size=20,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size=18
    ),
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = NA
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = NA
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 20,
      r = 80,
      b = 30,
      l = 100
    )
  )

# Keep intersection values readable across the full sage gradient.
# Large intersections occupy the darkest regions, so their labels switch to
# bold white; smaller values remain black on the pale regions.
venn_count_layer <- which(vapply(
  p_venn$layers,
  function(one_layer) inherits(one_layer$geom, "GeomLabel"),
  logical(1)
))

if (length(venn_count_layer)==1L) {
  p_venn$layers[[venn_count_layer]]$data <-
    p_venn$layers[[venn_count_layer]]$data %>%
    mutate(
      label_colour=if_else(count>=250, "white", "black")
    )

  p_venn$layers[[venn_count_layer]]$mapping$colour <-
    rlang::expr(I(.data$label_colour))

  p_venn$layers[[venn_count_layer]]$aes_params$colour <- NULL
  p_venn$layers[[venn_count_layer]]$aes_params$fontface <- "bold"
}

# ggVennDiagram assigns "sans" directly to its internal text layers. Override
# those layer-level defaults so set labels and intersection counts are Arial.
for (venn_layer_index in seq_along(p_venn$layers)) {
  if (inherits(
    p_venn$layers[[venn_layer_index]]$geom,
    c("GeomText", "GeomLabel")
  )) {
    p_venn$layers[[venn_layer_index]]$aes_params$family <- "Arial"
  }
}

print(p_venn)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    venn_dir,
    "Venn_total_5methods.png"
  ),
  p_venn,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    venn_dir,
    "Venn_total_5methods.pdf"
  ),
  p_venn,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  bg = "white"
)
```

##barplot
```{r}
## 8.8 proportion
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpattern)
library(colorspace)
library(scales)

############################################################
## 1. Output
############################################################

save_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output/RHYTHMIC_PROPORTION/"

dir.create(
  save_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

############################################################
## 2. Colors
############################################################

ALG_COLORS <- c(
  "GT"             = "#B1B0B2",
  "SRB"            = "#C8D5B9",
  "CircaCompare"   = "#CDDCE5",
  "HR"             = "#FAF3DD",
  "dryR"           = "#F8DDDA",
  "JTK"            = "#E1D7D0"
)

nonrhythmic_colors <- colorspace::lighten(
  ALG_COLORS,
  amount = 0.45
)

############################################################
## 3. Convert rhythmic.df to long format
############################################################

plot_df <- rhythmic.df %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    GT,
    scRhythmBayes,
    CircaCompare,
    HarmonicRegression,
    dryR,
    JTK
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "Algorithm",
    values_to = "Rhythmic"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Algorithm = dplyr::recode(
      Algorithm,
      GT = "GT",
      scRhythmBayes = "SRB",
      CircaCompare = "CircaCompare",
      HarmonicRegression = "HR",
      dryR = "dryR",
      JTK = "JTK"
    )
  )

############################################################
## 4. Calculate proportions
############################################################

proportion_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Algorithm,
    Rhythmic,
    name = "Gene_number"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Algorithm
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total_gene = sum(Gene_number),
    Proportion = Gene_number / Total_gene
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Algorithm = factor(
      Algorithm,
      levels = c(
        "GT",
        "SRB",
        "CircaCompare",
        "HR",
        "dryR",
        "JTK"
      )
    ),
    Rhythmic = factor(
      Rhythmic,
      levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
      labels = c(
        "Non-rhythmic",
        "Rhythmic"
      )
    )
  )

############################################################
## 5. Fill groups
############################################################

proportion_df <- proportion_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Fill_group = paste(
      Algorithm,
      Rhythmic,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )

fill_colors <- c(
  setNames(
    unname(ALG_COLORS),
    paste0(
      names(ALG_COLORS),
      "_Rhythmic"
    )
  ),
  setNames(
    unname(nonrhythmic_colors),
    paste0(
      names(nonrhythmic_colors),
      "_Non-rhythmic"
    )
  )
)

############################################################
## 6. Label positions
############################################################

label_df <- proportion_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      Rhythmic == "Rhythmic" ~ Proportion / 2,
      Rhythmic == "Non-rhythmic" ~ 1 - Proportion / 2
    )
  )

############################################################
## 7. Plot
############################################################

p_proportion <- ggplot(
  label_df,
  aes(
    x = Algorithm,
    y = Proportion,
    fill = Fill_group
  )
) +
  geom_col_pattern(
    aes(
      pattern = Rhythmic
    ),
    width = 0.72,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    pattern_colour = "white",
    pattern_fill = "white",
    pattern_angle = 45,
    pattern_spacing = 0.035,
    pattern_density = 0.15,
    pattern_size = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_pattern_manual(
    values = c(
      "Rhythmic" = "none",
      "Non-rhythmic" = "stripe"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Rhythmic",
      "Non-rhythmic"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = label_y,
      label = scales::percent(
        Proportion,
        accuracy = 0.1
      )
    ),
    size=6.5,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = fill_colors,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    labels = scales::percent_format(
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.02)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Rhythmic-gene call composition",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of genes"
  ) +
  theme_figure3() +
  theme(
```

```{r}
# Figure 3: gene-level benchmark overview heatmap
# Final soft Nature palette

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(funkyheatmap)
  library(purrr)
})

stopifnot(
  exists("rhythmic.df"),
  exists("auc_df"),
  exists("mesor_metric_total"),
  exists("amplitude_metric_total"),
  exists("phase_metric_total")
)

figure3_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output"

figure3F_dir <- file.path(
  figure3_dir,
  "FUNKYHEATMAP"
)

dir.create(
  figure3F_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Method information

figure3F_method_info <- tribble(
  ~method,              ~level, ~input,  ~time_axis,   ~model,   ~criterion,  ~mesor, ~amplitude, ~phase, ~differential,
  "scRhythmBayes",      "Cell", "Count", "Cell phase", "ZINB",   "FDR<0.05",  "✓",    "✓",        "✓",    "✓",
  "CircaCompare",       "PB",   "Norm",  "ZT",         "Cosine", "p<0.01",    "✓",    "✓",        "✓",    "✓",
  "HarmonicRegression", "PB",   "Norm",  "ZT",         "HR",     "q<0.05",    "✓",    "✓",        "✓",    "–",
  "dryR",               "PB",   "Count", "ZT",         "NB-GLM", "BICW≥0.95", "✓",    "✓",        "✓",    "✓",
  "JTK",                "PB",   "Norm",  "ZT",         "Rank",   "BH.Q<0.05", "–",    "✓",        "✓",    "–"
)

# Detection performance

figure3F_detection <- purrr::map_dfr(
  figure3F_method_info$method,
  function(m) {

    truth <- as.logical(rhythmic.df$GT)
    pred <- as.logical(rhythmic.df[[m]])

    TP <- sum(truth & pred, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(!truth & pred, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(truth & !pred, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(!truth & !pred, na.rm = TRUE)

    sensitivity <- TP / (TP + FN)
    specificity <- TN / (TN + FP)
    precision <- TP / (TP + FP)

    F1 <- ifelse(
      precision + sensitivity > 0,
      2 * precision * sensitivity / (precision + sensitivity),
      NA_real_
    )

    tibble(
      method = m,
      calls = sum(pred, na.rm = TRUE),
      sensitivity = sensitivity,
      specificity = specificity,
      precision = precision,
      F1 = F1,
      TP = TP,
      FP = FP,
      FN = FN,
      TN = TN
    )
  }
)

# ROC AUC

figure3F_auc <- auc_df %>%
  transmute(
    method = as.character(Method),
    AUC = as.numeric(AUC)
  )

# Mesor recovery

figure3F_mesor <- mesor_metric_total %>%
  transmute(
    method = as.character(Algorithm),
    mesor_MAE = as.numeric(MAE),
    mesor_RMSE = as.numeric(RMSE),
    mesor_R2 = as.numeric(R2)
  )

# Amplitude recovery

figure3F_amplitude <- amplitude_metric_total %>%

    amplitude_MAE = as.numeric(MAE),
    amplitude_RMSE = as.numeric(RMSE),
    amplitude_R2 = as.numeric(R2)

# Phase recovery

figure3F_phase <- phase_metric_total %>%
  transmute(
    method = as.character(Algorithm),
    phase_MAE = as.numeric(MAE),
    phase_RMSE = as.numeric(RMSE)
  )

# Rank-score function
# Lower error = better
# Best method = 1
# Worst method = 0

figure3F_rank_score <- function(x) {

  r <- rank(
    x,
    ties.method = "average",
    na.last = "keep"
  )

  rmax <- max(
    r,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (!is.finite(rmax) || rmax <= 1) {
    return(
      ifelse(
        is.finite(x),
        1,
        NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  1 - (r - 1) / (rmax - 1)
}

# Merge all information

figure3F_data <- figure3F_method_info %>%
  left_join(
    figure3F_detection,
    by = "method"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    figure3F_auc,
    by = "method"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    figure3F_mesor,
    by = "method"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    figure3F_amplitude,
    by = "method"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    figure3F_phase,
    by = "method"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = c(
        "scRhythmBayes",
        "CircaCompare",
        "HarmonicRegression",
        "dryR",
        "JTK"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(method) %>%
  mutate(
    method = as.character(method),
    id = method,

    calls_score = calls / nrow(rhythmic.df),

    calls_label = ifelse(
      is.finite(calls),

    ),

    sensitivity_label = ifelse(

    ),

      "NA"
    ),

    mesor_R2_score = ifelse(
      is.finite(mesor_R2),
      pmax(0, pmin(1, mesor_R2)),

    ),

    mesor_R2_label = ifelse(
      is.finite(mesor_R2),
      sprintf("%.3f", mesor_R2),

    ),

    amplitude_R2_score = ifelse(
```

#simulation data
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(circular)
  library(dplyr)
  library(Matrix)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
})

reference_sim <- qread(
  "/path/to/scRhythmBayes/R/simulation_data_replicates.qs"
)

fixed_gene_truth <- as.data.frame(
  reference_sim$gene_meta
)

required_truth_columns <- c(
  "gene",
  "module",
  "M",
  "alpha",
  "A_base",
  "phi_base",
  "A_cond_1",
  "A_cond_2",
  "phi_cond_1",
  "phi_cond_2",
  "delta_amp_log2fc",
  "delta_phase_rad",
  "delta_phase_hour"
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    required_truth_columns %in%
      colnames(fixed_gene_truth)
  )
)

cat(
  "Genes:",
  nrow(fixed_gene_truth),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Null genes in cond_1:",
  sum(fixed_gene_truth$A_cond_1 == 0),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Null genes in cond_2:",
  sum(fixed_gene_truth$A_cond_2 == 0),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Null genes in both conditions:",
  sum(
    fixed_gene_truth$A_cond_1 == 0 &
      fixed_gene_truth$A_cond_2 == 0
  ),
  "\n"
)

simulate_sc_circadian_fixed_truth <- function(
  gene_meta,
  n_replicates = 3,
  cells_per_sample = 100,
  ZT_levels = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20),
  phase_kappa_true = 10,
  sigma_rep_mesor = 0.10,
  sigma_rep_phase_hour = 0.30,
  log_sf_sd = 0.45,
  dropout_b0 = 1.0,
  dropout_b1 = -0.8,
  p_alpha = 5,
  p_beta = 2,
  kappa_min = 3,
  kappa_max = 30,
  sampling_seed = 1001,
  show_progress = FALSE
) {

  set.seed(
    sampling_seed
  )

  wrap_angle <- function(x) {
    x %% (2 * pi)
  }

  G <- nrow(
    gene_meta
  )

  gene_ids <- as.character(
    gene_meta$gene
  )

  M_g <- gene_meta$M
  alpha_g <- gene_meta$alpha

  A_cond_1 <- gene_meta$A_cond_1
  A_cond_2 <- gene_meta$A_cond_2

  phi_cond_1 <- gene_meta$phi_cond_1
  phi_cond_2 <- gene_meta$phi_cond_2

  groups <- c(
    "cond_1",
    "cond_2"
  )

  reps <- paste0(
    "rep",
    seq_len(
      n_replicates
    )
  )

  sample_meta <- expand.grid(
    group = groups,
    replicate = reps,
    ZT_bin_num = ZT_levels,
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    arrange(
      group,
      replicate,
      ZT_bin_num
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ZT_bin = factor(
        paste0(
          "ZT",
          ZT_bin_num
        ),
        levels = paste0(
          "ZT",
          ZT_levels
        )
      ),
      sample = paste(
        group,
        replicate,
        paste0(
          "ZT",
          ZT_bin_num
        ),
        sep = "_"
      )
    )

  cell_meta <- sample_meta[
    rep(
      seq_len(
        nrow(sample_meta)
      ),
      each = cells_per_sample
    ),
  ]

  cell_meta$cell <- paste0(
    "Cell",
    seq_len(
      nrow(cell_meta)
    )
  )

  N <- nrow(
    cell_meta
  )

  theta_center <- cell_meta$ZT_bin_num /
    24 *
    2 *
    pi

  theta_true <- numeric(
    N
  )

  if (
    show_progress
  ) {
    pb_phase <- txtProgressBar(
      min = 0,
      max = N,
      style = 3
    )
  }

  for (
    i in seq_len(N)
  ) {

    theta_true[i] <- as.numeric(
      circular::rvonmises(
        1,
        mu = circular::circular(
          theta_center[i]
        ),
        kappa = phase_kappa_true
      )
    ) %% (
      2 * pi
    )

    if (
      show_progress
    ) {
      setTxtProgressBar(
        pb_phase,
        i
      )
    }
  }

  if (
    show_progress
  ) {
    close(
      pb_phase
    )
  }

  p_cell <- rbeta(
    N,
    p_alpha,
    p_beta
  )

  kappa_i <- kappa_min +
    (
      kappa_max -
        kappa_min
    ) *
    p_cell

  theta_obs <- numeric(
    N
  )

  if (
    show_progress
  ) {
    pb_obs <- txtProgressBar(
      min = 0,
      max = N,
      style = 3
    )
  }

  for (
    i in seq_len(N)
  ) {

    theta_obs[i] <- as.numeric(
      circular::rvonmises(
        1,
        mu = circular::circular(
          theta_true[i]
        ),
        kappa = kappa_i[i]
      )
    ) %% (
      2 * pi
    )

    if (
      show_progress
    ) {
      setTxtProgressBar(
        pb_obs,
        i
      )
    }
  }

  if (
    show_progress
  ) {
    close(
      pb_obs
    )
  }

  log_sf <- rnorm(
    N,
    0,
    log_sf_sd
  )

  sf <- exp(
    log_sf
  )

  sample_ids <- sample_meta$sample

  sample_mesor <- matrix(
    rnorm(
      G *
        length(
          sample_ids
        ),
      0,
      sigma_rep_mesor
    ),
    nrow = G,
    ncol = length(
      sample_ids
    ),
    dimnames = list(
      gene_ids,
      sample_ids
    )
  )

  sample_phase_hour <- rnorm(
    length(
      sample_ids
    ),
    0,
    sigma_rep_phase_hour
  )

  names(
    sample_phase_hour
  ) <- sample_ids

  sample_phase_rad <- sample_phase_hour /
    24 *
    2 *
    pi

  sample_idx <- match(
    cell_meta$sample,
    sample_ids
  )

  group <- cell_meta$group

  Y <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = G,
    ncol = N
  )

  if (
    show_progress
  ) {
    pb_counts <- txtProgressBar(
      min = 0,
      max = G,
      style = 3
    )
  }

  for (
    g in seq_len(G)
  ) {

    amp_vec <- ifelse(
      group == "cond_1",
      A_cond_1[g],
      A_cond_2[g]
    )

    phi_vec <- ifelse(
      group == "cond_1",
      phi_cond_1[g],
      phi_cond_2[g]
    )

    phi_vec <- wrap_angle(
      phi_vec +
        sample_phase_rad[
          sample_idx
        ]
    )

    mesor_vec <- M_g[g] +
      sample_mesor[
        g,
        sample_idx
      ]

    log_mu <- mesor_vec +
      amp_vec *
      cos(
        theta_true -
          phi_vec
      ) +
      log_sf

    mu <- exp(
      log_mu
    )

    pi_drop <- plogis(
      dropout_b0 +
        dropout_b1 *
        log(
          mu + 1
        )
    )

    is_drop <- rbinom(
      N,
      1,
      pi_drop
    )

    counts <- rnbinom(
      N,
      mu = mu,
      size = 1 /
        alpha_g[g]
    )

    counts[
      is_drop == 1
    ] <- 0

    Y[
      g,
    ] <- counts

    if (
      show_progress
    ) {
      setTxtProgressBar(
        pb_counts,
        g
      )
    }
  }

  if (
    show_progress
  ) {
    close(
      pb_counts
    )
  }

  rownames(
    Y
  ) <- gene_ids

  colnames(
    Y
  ) <- cell_meta$cell

  cell_meta <- cell_meta %>%
    mutate(
      theta_true = theta_true,
      theta_obs = theta_obs,
      ZT_true_hour = theta_true /
        (
          2 * pi
        ) *
        24,
      p = p_cell,
      kappa = kappa_i,
      size_factor = sf,
      log_sf = log_sf
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      cell,
      sample,
      group,
      replicate,
      ZT_bin_num,
      ZT_bin,
      theta_true,
      theta_obs,
      ZT_true_hour,
      p,
      kappa,
      size_factor,
      log_sf
    )

  sample_meta$n_cells <- cells_per_sample

  list(
    counts = Y,

    gene_meta = gene_meta,

    cell_meta = cell_meta,

    sample_meta = sample_meta,

    sample_effects = list(
      mesor = sample_mesor,
      phase_hour = sample_phase_hour
    ),

    params = list(
      sampling_seed = sampling_seed,
      n_replicates = n_replicates,
      cells_per_sample = cells_per_sample,
      ZT_levels = ZT_levels,
      phase_kappa_true = phase_kappa_true,
      sigma_rep_mesor = sigma_rep_mesor,
      sigma_rep_phase_hour = sigma_rep_phase_hour,
      log_sf_sd = log_sf_sd,
      dropout_b0 = dropout_b0,
      dropout_b1 = dropout_b1,
      p_alpha = p_alpha,
      p_beta = p_beta,
      kappa_min = kappa_min,
      kappa_max = kappa_max,
      truth_source = "simulation_data_replicates.qs"
    )
  )
}
```

#empirical null P-value and FDR calibration
```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
})

simulation_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Projects/scRhythmBayes_simulation/data/FDR_calibration"

calibration_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output/FDR_calibration"

result_dir <- file.path(
  calibration_dir,
  "per_simulation_results"
)

dir.create(
  result_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  exists("infer_gene_param")
)

simulation_files <- list.files(
  simulation_dir,
  pattern = "^simulation_fixedtruth_seed[0-9]+\\.qs$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

simulation_files <- simulation_files[
  order(
    as.integer(
      sub(
        ".*seed([0-9]+)\\.qs$",
        "\\1",
        simulation_files
      )
    )
  )
]

stopifnot(
  length(simulation_files) == 50
)

simulation_seeds <- as.integer(
  sub(
    ".*seed([0-9]+)\\.qs$",
    "\\1",
    simulation_files
  )
)

batch_manifest <- tibble(
  sim_id = seq_along(simulation_files),
  seed = simulation_seeds,
  simulation_file = simulation_files,
  result_file = file.path(
    result_dir,
    paste0(
      "SRB_calibration_seed",
      simulation_seeds,
      ".qs"
    )
  )
)

print(
  batch_manifest
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(batch_manifest))) {

  sim_id <- batch_manifest$sim_id[i]
  seed_i <- batch_manifest$seed[i]
  input_file <- batch_manifest$simulation_file[i]
  output_file <- batch_manifest$result_file[i]

  if (file.exists(output_file)) {

    cat(
      "[",
      sim_id,
      "/50] already finished: seed ",
      seed_i,
      "\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    next
  }

  cat(
    "\n[",
    sim_id,
    "/50] running scRhythmBayes: seed ",
    seed_i,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  sim.dat <- qs::qread(
    input_file
  )

  counts <- sim.dat$counts

  meta <- as.data.frame(
    sim.dat$cell_meta
  )

  gene_meta <- as.data.frame(
    sim.dat$gene_meta
  )

  meta <- meta[
    match(
      colnames(counts),
      meta$cell
    ),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  gene_meta <- gene_meta[
    match(
      rownames(counts),
      gene_meta$gene
    ),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  stopifnot(
    all(
      colnames(counts) ==
        meta$cell
    )
  )

  stopifnot(
    all(
      rownames(counts) ==
        gene_meta$gene
    )
  )

  res_srb <- infer_gene_param(
    count = counts,
    metadata = meta,
    theta_pred = meta$theta_obs,
    r_cell = meta$p,
    strata_by = "group",
    ZT_by = "ZT_bin_num",
    sample_by = "sample",
    sample_boot_by = "ZT_bin",
    n_worker = 4,
    setseed = seed_i,
    Verbose = TRUE
  )

  truth_long <- bind_rows(
    tibble(
      gene = gene_meta$gene,
      group = "cond_1",
      A_truth = gene_meta$A_cond_1
    ),
    tibble(
      gene = gene_meta$gene,
      group = "cond_2",
      A_truth = gene_meta$A_cond_2
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      is_null = A_truth == 0,
      is_rhythmic = A_truth > 0
    )

  calibration_one <- res_srb$param_long %>%
    transmute(
      gene = as.character(gene),
      group = as.character(group),
      P_value = as.numeric(P_value),
      FDR = as.numeric(FDR)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      truth_long,
      by = c(
        "gene",
        "group"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sim_id = sim_id,
      seed = seed_i
    )

  stopifnot(
    nrow(calibration_one) == 8000
  )

  stopifnot(
    sum(
      calibration_one$is_null &
        calibration_one$group == "cond_1"
    ) == 1000
  )

  stopifnot(
    sum(
      calibration_one$is_null &
        calibration_one$group == "cond_2"
    ) == 1000
  )

  qs::qsave(
    calibration_one,
    output_file
  )

  cat(
    "saved: ",
    basename(output_file),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  rm(
    sim.dat,
    counts,
    meta,
    gene_meta,
    truth_long,
    res_srb,
    calibration_one
  )

  gc()
}

write.csv(
  batch_manifest,
  file.path(
    calibration_dir,
    "SRB_calibration_batch_manifest.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nCompleted calibration results: ",
  sum(
    file.exists(
      batch_manifest$result_file
    )
  ),
  "/50\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

#null P-value calibration and realized FDR
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

calibration_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output/FDR_calibration"
result_dir <- file.path(calibration_dir,"per_simulation_results")

result_files <- list.files(result_dir,pattern="^SRB_calibration_seed[0-9]+\\.qs$",full.names=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(result_files)>=3)

calibration_all <- purrr::map_dfr(result_files,qs::qread)
n_sim <- dplyr::n_distinct(calibration_all$sim_id)

cat("Completed independent simulations:",n_sim,"\n")
cat("Total gene-condition tests:",nrow(calibration_all),"\n")
cat("Total true-null gene-condition tests:",sum(calibration_all$is_null),"\n")

print(calibration_all %>% dplyr::count(sim_id,group,is_null))

null_p <- calibration_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(is_null,is.finite(P_value),P_value>=0,P_value<=1)

null_summary <- null_p %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_null_tests=dplyr::n(),
    mean_P=mean(P_value,na.rm=TRUE),
    median_P=median(P_value,na.rm=TRUE),
    empirical_alpha_001=mean(P_value<=0.01,na.rm=TRUE),
    empirical_alpha_005=mean(P_value<=0.05,na.rm=TRUE),
    empirical_alpha_010=mean(P_value<=0.10,na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )

print(null_summary)

alpha_grid <- c(0.01,0.025,0.05,0.075,0.10,0.15,0.20)

null_calibration_by_sim <- null_p %>%
  dplyr::select(sim_id,group,P_value) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(nominal_alpha=alpha_grid) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sim_id,group,nominal_alpha) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    empirical_type1=mean(P_value<=nominal_alpha,na.rm=TRUE),
    n_null=dplyr::n(),
    .groups="drop"
  )

null_calibration_summary <- null_calibration_by_sim %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group,nominal_alpha) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_type1=mean(empirical_type1,na.rm=TRUE),
    min_type1=min(empirical_type1,na.rm=TRUE),
    max_type1=max(empirical_type1,na.rm=TRUE),
    sd_type1=sd(empirical_type1,na.rm=TRUE),
    n_sim=dplyr::n(),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(empirical_type1=mean_type1)

print(null_calibration_summary)

fdr_grid <- c(0.01,0.025,0.05,0.075,0.10,0.15,0.20)

fdr_by_sim <- calibration_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(FDR)) %>%
  dplyr::select(sim_id,group,gene,FDR,is_null) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(nominal_FDR=fdr_grid) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sim_id,group,nominal_FDR) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    discoveries=sum(FDR<=nominal_FDR,na.rm=TRUE),
    false_discoveries=sum(FDR<=nominal_FDR & is_null,na.rm=TRUE),
    true_discoveries=sum(FDR<=nominal_FDR & !is_null,na.rm=TRUE),
    FDP=false_discoveries/pmax(discoveries,1),
    .groups="drop"
  )

fdr_summary <- fdr_by_sim %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group,nominal_FDR) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    realized_FDR=mean(FDP,na.rm=TRUE),
    min_FDP=min(FDP,na.rm=TRUE),
    max_FDP=max(FDP,na.rm=TRUE),
    sd_FDP=sd(FDP,na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_discoveries=mean(discoveries,na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_false_discoveries=mean(false_discoveries,na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_true_discoveries=mean(true_discoveries,na.rm=TRUE),
    n_sim=dplyr::n(),
    .groups="drop"
  )

print(fdr_summary)

null_at_005 <- null_calibration_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(abs(nominal_alpha-0.05)<1e-12)

fdr_at_005 <- fdr_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(abs(nominal_FDR-0.05)<1e-12)

cat("\nEmpirical type-I error at nominal alpha = 0.05:\n")
print(null_at_005)

cat("\nMonte Carlo realized FDR at nominal FDR = 0.05:\n")
print(fdr_at_005)

cat("\nPer-simulation type-I error at alpha = 0.05:\n")
print(
  null_calibration_by_sim %>%
    dplyr::filter(abs(nominal_alpha-0.05)<1e-12) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(group,sim_id),
  n=Inf
)
```

# Part 6. Updated native selective parameter recovery
# Native selective parameter recovery: Parameter risk versus coverage

## 1. Standalone setup and reload saved results
