## 2. Build truth and method-native parameter tables

```{r native-risk-coverage-build}
# Truth is already stored in hours for phase.
parameter_truth_all <- benchmark_input_native$truth_long %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    Condition = recode(group, "cond_1" = "cond1", "cond_2" = "cond2"),
    Truth_amplitude = as.numeric(A_truth),
    Truth_phase = as.numeric(phase_truth) %% 24
  )

if (anyDuplicated(parameter_truth_all[c("gene", "Condition")])) {
  stop("truth_long contains duplicated gene-condition pairs.")
}

true_rhythmic_pairs <- parameter_truth_all %>%
  filter(Truth_amplitude > 0)

# scRhythmBayes final v2: amplitude and phase follow the simulator convention.
SRB_parameter_native <- SRB_native$param_long %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    Condition = recode(group, "cond_1" = "cond1", "cond_2" = "cond2"),
    Method = "scRhythmBayes",
    Amplitude_raw = as.numeric(Amplitude),
    Phase_estimate = (as.numeric(Phase) %% (2 * pi)) * 24 / (2 * pi),
    Selected = is.finite(FDR) & FDR < 0.05
  )

# HarmonicRegression: phi is radians in the same peak-phase convention as truth.
HR_gene_cond1_native <- names(HR_cond1_native$qvals)
HR_gene_cond2_native <- names(HR_cond2_native$qvals)
if (is.null(HR_gene_cond1_native)) {
  HR_gene_cond1_native <- rownames(benchmark_input_native$pseudobulk_expression)
}
if (is.null(HR_gene_cond2_native)) {
  HR_gene_cond2_native <- rownames(benchmark_input_native$pseudobulk_expression)
}

HR_parameter_native <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    gene = HR_gene_cond1_native,
    Condition = "cond1",
    Method = "HarmonicRegression",
    Amplitude_raw = as.numeric(HR_cond1_native$pars$amp),
    Phase_estimate = (as.numeric(HR_cond1_native$pars$phi) %% (2 * pi)) * 24 / (2 * pi),
    Selected = is.finite(HR_cond1_native$qvals) & HR_cond1_native$qvals < 0.05
  ),
  tibble(
    gene = HR_gene_cond2_native,
    Condition = "cond2",
    Method = "HarmonicRegression",
    Amplitude_raw = as.numeric(HR_cond2_native$pars$amp),
    Phase_estimate = (as.numeric(HR_cond2_native$pars$phi) %% (2 * pi)) * 24 / (2 * pi),
    Selected = is.finite(HR_cond2_native$qvals) & HR_cond2_native$qvals < 0.05
  )
)

# CircaCompare stores one fitted object per gene, so only this short extractor is needed.
CC_native_to_long <- function(CC_list, condition_name) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(CC_list), function(gene_name) {
    fit_object <- CC_list[[gene_name]]

    if (inherits(fit_object, "error") || is.null(fit_object$summary)) {
      return(tibble(
        gene = gene_name,
        Condition = condition_name,
        Method = "CircaCompare",
        Amplitude_raw = NA_real_,
        Phase_estimate = NA_real_,
        Selected = FALSE
      ))
    }

    fit_values <- setNames(
      as.numeric(fit_object$summary$value),
      fit_object$summary$parameter
    )

    rhythmic_p <- unname(fit_values["rhythmic_p"])
    tibble(
      gene = gene_name,
      Condition = condition_name,
      Method = "CircaCompare",
      Amplitude_raw = unname(fit_values["amplitude"]),
      Phase_estimate = unname(fit_values["peak_time_hours"]) %% 24,
      Selected = is.finite(rhythmic_p) & rhythmic_p < 0.01
    )
  }))
}

CC_parameter_native <- bind_rows(
  CC_native_to_long(CC_cond1_native, "cond1"),
  CC_native_to_long(CC_cond2_native, "cond2")
)

# dryR native source check: $parameters is the selected-model parameter table.
if (!identical(rownames(dryR_native$results), rownames(dryR_native$parameters))) {
  stop("dryR result and parameter row names are not aligned.")
}
if (!isTRUE(all.equal(
  dryR_native$results$amp_cond_1,
  dryR_native$parameters$amp_cond_1
))) {
  stop("dryR native amplitude differs between $results and $parameters.")
}
if (!isTRUE(all.equal(
  dryR_native$results$phase_cond_1,
  dryR_native$parameters$phase_cond_1
))) {
  stop("dryR native phase differs between $results and $parameters.")
}

dryR_max_cook_native <- apply(dryR_native$cook, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
dryR_max_cook_native[!is.finite(dryR_max_cook_native)] <- Inf

dryR_parameter_wide_native <- as.data.frame(dryR_native$parameters) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  left_join(
    tibble(
      gene = rownames(dryR_native$results),
      Native_BICW = as.numeric(dryR_native$results$chosen_model_BICW),
      Max_Cook = as.numeric(dryR_max_cook_native)
    ),
    by = "gene"
  )

dryR_parameter_native <- bind_rows(
  dryR_parameter_wide_native %>%
    transmute(
      gene,
      Condition = "cond1",
      Method = "dryR",
      # dryR AMP is peak-to-trough on log2 scale. Convert to single
      # cosine amplitude on natural-log scale before OOF scale calibration.
      Amplitude_raw = as.numeric(amp_cond_1) * log(2) / 2,
      Phase_estimate = as.numeric(phase_cond_1) %% 24,
      Selected = is.finite(Native_BICW) & Native_BICW >= 0.95 &
        is.finite(Max_Cook) & Max_Cook <= 1 & is.finite(amp_cond_1)
    ),
  dryR_parameter_wide_native %>%
    transmute(
      gene,
      Condition = "cond2",
      Method = "dryR",
      Amplitude_raw = as.numeric(amp_cond_2) * log(2) / 2,
      Phase_estimate = as.numeric(phase_cond_2) %% 24,
      Selected = is.finite(Native_BICW) & Native_BICW >= 0.95 &
        is.finite(Max_Cook) & Max_Cook <= 1 & is.finite(amp_cond_2)
    )
)

# JTK_CYCLE: MetaCycle AMP is used as saved; LAG is peak phase in hours.
JTK_parameter_native <- bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(JTK_cond1_native$JTK) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = as.character(CycID),
      Condition = "cond1",
      Method = "JTK",
      Amplitude_raw = as.numeric(AMP),
      Phase_estimate = as.numeric(LAG) %% 24,
      Selected = is.finite(BH.Q) & BH.Q < 0.05
    ),
  as.data.frame(JTK_cond2_native$JTK) %>%
    transmute(
      gene = as.character(CycID),
      Condition = "cond2",
      Method = "JTK",
      Amplitude_raw = as.numeric(AMP),
      Phase_estimate = as.numeric(LAG) %% 24,
      Selected = is.finite(BH.Q) & BH.Q < 0.05
    )
)

native_parameter_raw <- bind_rows(
  SRB_parameter_native,
  CC_parameter_native,
  HR_parameter_native,
  dryR_parameter_native,
  JTK_parameter_native
) %>%
  mutate(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    Selected = replace_na(as.logical(Selected), FALSE)
  )

native_duplicate_keys <- native_parameter_raw %>%
  dplyr::count(Method, gene, Condition) %>%
  filter(n != 1)
if (nrow(native_duplicate_keys) > 0) {
  stop("At least one method has duplicated or missing gene-condition keys.")
}

native_parameter_joined <- native_parameter_raw %>%
  inner_join(parameter_truth_all, by = c("gene", "Condition"))

# Use exactly the same condition-specific, gene-wise 10-fold OOF amplitude
# calibration strategy as the existing amplitude-recovery section. The fold is
# assigned by gene, so the same gene never appears in both train and test folds.
set.seed(202606)
native_fold_key <- tibble(
  gene = sort(unique(parameter_truth_all$gene)),
  fold = sample(rep(1:10, length.out = n_distinct(parameter_truth_all$gene)))
)

OOF_calibrate_amplitude <- function(parameter_table) {
  parameter_table <- parameter_table %>%
    left_join(native_fold_key, by = "gene")

  SRB_direct <- parameter_table %>%
    filter(Method == "scRhythmBayes") %>%
    transmute(Method, gene, Condition, Amplitude_estimate = Amplitude_raw)

  comparator_calibrated <- bind_rows(lapply(
    setdiff(native_method_order, "scRhythmBayes"),
    function(method_name) {
      bind_rows(lapply(c("cond1", "cond2"), function(condition_name) {
        one_table <- parameter_table %>%
          filter(Method == method_name, Condition == condition_name)

        bind_rows(lapply(1:10, function(fold_number) {
          training_table <- one_table %>%
            filter(
              fold != fold_number,
              is.finite(Amplitude_raw),
              is.finite(Truth_amplitude)
            )
          test_table <- one_table %>%
            filter(
              fold == fold_number,
              is.finite(Amplitude_raw),
              is.finite(Truth_amplitude)
            )

          if (nrow(test_table) == 0) {
            return(NULL)
          }
          if (nrow(training_table) < 3 ||
              length(unique(training_table$Amplitude_raw)) < 2) {
            return(test_table %>%
              transmute(
                Method,
                gene,
                Condition,
                Amplitude_estimate = NA_real_
              ))
          }

          amplitude_fit <- lm(
            Truth_amplitude ~ Amplitude_raw,
            data = training_table
          )

          test_table %>%
            transmute(
              Method,
              gene,
              Condition,
              Amplitude_estimate = pmax(
                0,
                as.numeric(predict(amplitude_fit, newdata = test_table))
              )
            )
        }))
      }))
    }
  ))

  bind_rows(SRB_direct, comparator_calibrated)
}

native_amplitude_calibrated <- OOF_calibrate_amplitude(native_parameter_joined)

native_parameter_estimates <- native_parameter_joined %>%
  left_join(
    native_amplitude_calibrated,
    by = c("Method", "gene", "Condition")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Phase_estimate = Phase_estimate %% 24,
    Phase_absolute_error = abs(
      ((Phase_estimate - Truth_phase + 12) %% 24) - 12
    )
  )

cat("True rhythmic gene-condition pairs:", nrow(true_rhythmic_pairs), "\n")
cat("Native table rows:", nrow(native_parameter_estimates), "\n")
```

## 3. Native operating-point summary

```{r native-risk-coverage-summary}
native_amplitude_summary <- native_parameter_estimates %>%
  filter(Truth_amplitude > 0) %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarise(
    N_truth = n(),
    N_recovered = sum(Selected & is.finite(Amplitude_estimate)),
    Risk_MAE = {
      keep <- Selected & is.finite(Amplitude_estimate)
      if (any(keep)) {
        mean(abs(Amplitude_estimate[keep] - Truth_amplitude[keep]))
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Parameter = "Amplitude",
    Coverage = N_recovered / N_truth
  )

native_phase_summary <- native_parameter_estimates %>%
  filter(Truth_amplitude > 0) %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarise(
    N_truth = n(),
    N_recovered = sum(Selected & is.finite(Phase_estimate)),
    Risk_MAE = {
      keep <- Selected & is.finite(Phase_estimate)
      if (any(keep)) mean(Phase_absolute_error[keep]) else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Parameter = "Phase",
    Coverage = N_recovered / N_truth
  )

native_parameter_risk_coverage <- bind_rows(
  native_amplitude_summary,
  native_phase_summary
) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = native_method_order),
    Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = c("Amplitude", "Phase"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Parameter, Method) %>%
  select(Method, Parameter, N_truth, N_recovered, Coverage, Risk_MAE)

# The same summary split by condition is saved as source data, but is not needed
# in the proposed main plot.
native_amplitude_by_condition <- native_parameter_estimates %>%
  filter(Truth_amplitude > 0) %>%
  group_by(Method, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    N_truth = n(),
    N_recovered = sum(Selected & is.finite(Amplitude_estimate)),
    Risk_MAE = {
      keep <- Selected & is.finite(Amplitude_estimate)
      if (any(keep)) {
        mean(abs(Amplitude_estimate[keep] - Truth_amplitude[keep]))
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = "Amplitude", Coverage = N_recovered / N_truth)

native_phase_by_condition <- native_parameter_estimates %>%
  filter(Truth_amplitude > 0) %>%
  group_by(Method, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    N_truth = n(),
    N_recovered = sum(Selected & is.finite(Phase_estimate)),
    Risk_MAE = {
      keep <- Selected & is.finite(Phase_estimate)
      if (any(keep)) mean(Phase_absolute_error[keep]) else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Parameter = "Phase", Coverage = N_recovered / N_truth)

native_parameter_risk_coverage_by_condition <- bind_rows(
  native_amplitude_by_condition,
  native_phase_by_condition
) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = native_method_order),
    Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = c("Amplitude", "Phase"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Parameter, Method, Condition) %>%
  select(
    Method,
    Parameter,
    Condition,
    N_truth,
    N_recovered,
    Coverage,
    Risk_MAE
  )

print(native_parameter_risk_coverage, n = Inf)

readr::write_tsv(
  native_parameter_risk_coverage,

)
readr::write_tsv(

qs::qsave(
```

## 5. Optional supplement: full-model and common-truth sensitivity

```{r native-full-model-common-truth-sensitivity}
run_optional_sensitivity <- FALSE

if (run_optional_sensitivity) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

  dryR_full_coef <- stats::coef(dryR_native$dds.full)
  dryR_required_coef <- c("a.1", "b.1", "a.2", "b.2")
  if (!all(dryR_required_coef %in% colnames(dryR_full_coef))) {
    stop("dryR dds.full does not contain the expected harmonic coefficients.")
  }

  dryR_full_parameter <- bind_rows(
    tibble(
      gene = rownames(dryR_full_coef),
      Condition = "cond1",
      Method = "dryR",
      # DESeq2 coefficients are log2. Convert a single harmonic amplitude to ln.
      Amplitude_raw = sqrt(
        dryR_full_coef[, "a.1"]^2 + dryR_full_coef[, "b.1"]^2
      ) * log(2),
      Phase_estimate = (
        atan2(dryR_full_coef[, "b.1"], dryR_full_coef[, "a.1"]) %% (2 * pi)
      ) * 24 / (2 * pi),
      Selected = TRUE
    ),
    tibble(
      gene = rownames(dryR_full_coef),
      Condition = "cond2",
      Method = "dryR",
      Amplitude_raw = sqrt(
        dryR_full_coef[, "a.2"]^2 + dryR_full_coef[, "b.2"]^2
      ) * log(2),
      Phase_estimate = (
        atan2(dryR_full_coef[, "b.2"], dryR_full_coef[, "a.2"]) %% (2 * pi)
      ) * 24 / (2 * pi),
      Selected = TRUE
    )
  )

  full_model_parameter_raw <- bind_rows(
    native_parameter_raw %>%
      filter(Method != "dryR") %>%
      mutate(Selected = TRUE),
    dryR_full_parameter
  )

  full_model_parameter_joined <- full_model_parameter_raw %>%
    inner_join(parameter_truth_all, by = c("gene", "Condition"))

  full_model_amplitude_calibrated <- OOF_calibrate_amplitude(
    full_model_parameter_joined
  )

  full_model_parameter_estimates <- full_model_parameter_joined %>%
    left_join(
      full_model_amplitude_calibrated,
      by = c("Method", "gene", "Condition")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Phase_estimate = Phase_estimate %% 24,
      Phase_absolute_error = abs(
        ((Phase_estimate - Truth_phase + 12) %% 24) - 12
      )
    )

  full_model_amplitude_summary <- full_model_parameter_estimates %>%
    filter(Truth_amplitude > 0) %>%
    group_by(Method) %>%
    summarise(
      N_truth = n(),
      N_recovered = sum(is.finite(Amplitude_estimate)),
      Risk_MAE = {
        keep <- is.finite(Amplitude_estimate)
        if (any(keep)) {
          mean(abs(Amplitude_estimate[keep] - Truth_amplitude[keep]))
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Parameter = "Amplitude",
      Coverage = N_recovered / N_truth
    )

  full_model_phase_summary <- full_model_parameter_estimates %>%
    filter(Truth_amplitude > 0) %>%
    group_by(Method) %>%
    summarise(
      N_truth = n(),
      N_recovered = sum(is.finite(Phase_estimate)),
      Risk_MAE = {
        keep <- is.finite(Phase_estimate)
        if (any(keep)) mean(Phase_absolute_error[keep]) else NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Parameter = "Phase",
      Coverage = N_recovered / N_truth
    )

  sensitivity_full_model_risk_coverage <- bind_rows(
    full_model_amplitude_summary,
    full_model_phase_summary
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Method = factor(Method, levels = native_method_order),
      Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = c("Amplitude", "Phase"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(Parameter, Method) %>%
    select(Method, Parameter, N_truth, N_recovered, Coverage, Risk_MAE)

  common_amplitude_pairs <- full_model_parameter_estimates %>%
    filter(Truth_amplitude > 0, is.finite(Amplitude_estimate)) %>%
    group_by(gene, Condition) %>%
    summarise(N_method = n_distinct(Method), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(N_method == length(native_method_order)) %>%
    select(gene, Condition)

  common_phase_pairs <- full_model_parameter_estimates %>%
    filter(Truth_amplitude > 0, is.finite(Phase_estimate)) %>%
    group_by(gene, Condition) %>%
    summarise(N_method = n_distinct(Method), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(N_method == length(native_method_order)) %>%
    select(gene, Condition)

  common_amplitude_risk <- full_model_parameter_estimates %>%
    inner_join(common_amplitude_pairs, by = c("gene", "Condition")) %>%
    group_by(Method) %>%
    summarise(
      N_common = n(),
      Risk_MAE = mean(abs(Amplitude_estimate - Truth_amplitude)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Parameter = "Amplitude")

  common_phase_risk <- full_model_parameter_estimates %>%
    inner_join(common_phase_pairs, by = c("gene", "Condition")) %>%
    group_by(Method) %>%
    summarise(
      N_common = n(),
      Risk_MAE = mean(Phase_absolute_error),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Parameter = "Phase")

  sensitivity_common_truth_risk <- bind_rows(
    common_amplitude_risk,
    common_phase_risk
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Method = factor(Method, levels = native_method_order),
      Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = c("Amplitude", "Phase"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(Parameter, Method) %>%
    select(Method, Parameter, N_common, Risk_MAE)

  print(sensitivity_full_model_risk_coverage, n = Inf)
  print(sensitivity_common_truth_risk, n = Inf)

  readr::write_tsv(
    sensitivity_full_model_risk_coverage,
    file.path(
      native_output_dir,
      "sensitivity_full_model_parameter_risk_coverage.tsv"
    )
  )
  readr::write_tsv(
    sensitivity_common_truth_risk,
    file.path(
      native_output_dir,
      "sensitivity_common_truth_parameter_risk.tsv"
    )
  )
  qs::qsave(
    list(
      full_model_summary = sensitivity_full_model_risk_coverage,
      common_truth_summary = sensitivity_common_truth_risk,
      full_model_pair_level = full_model_parameter_estimates
    ),
    file.path(
      native_output_dir,
      "sensitivity_full_model_common_truth.qs"
    )
  )
}
```

## Complete native parameter-recovery metrics
```{r}
native_amplitude_metrics <- native_parameter_estimates %>%
  dplyr::filter(Truth_amplitude>0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Method) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    x <- .x %>% dplyr::filter(Selected,is.finite(Amplitude_estimate),is.finite(Truth_amplitude))
    err <- x$Amplitude_estimate-x$Truth_amplitude
    data.frame(
      N_truth=nrow(.x),
      N_recovered=nrow(x),
      Coverage=nrow(x)/nrow(.x),
      MAE=mean(abs(err)),
      MedAE=median(abs(err)),
      RMSE=sqrt(mean(err^2)),
      R2=1-sum(err^2)/sum((x$Truth_amplitude-mean(x$Truth_amplitude))^2)
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Parameter="Amplitude")

#phase
native_phase_metrics <- native_parameter_estimates %>%
  dplyr::filter(Truth_amplitude>0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Method) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    x <- .x %>% dplyr::filter(Selected,is.finite(Phase_estimate),is.finite(Truth_phase))
    err <- ((x$Phase_estimate-x$Truth_phase+12)%%24)-12

    truth_rad <- 2*pi*x$Truth_phase/24
    truth_mean_rad <- atan2(mean(sin(truth_rad)),mean(cos(truth_rad)))
    truth_mean_hour <- (truth_mean_rad%%(2*pi))*24/(2*pi)
    truth_dev <- ((x$Truth_phase-truth_mean_hour+12)%%24)-12

    pred_rad <- 2*pi*x$Phase_estimate/24
    phase_diff_rad <- atan2(sin(pred_rad-truth_rad),cos(pred_rad-truth_rad))
    truth_dev_rad <- atan2(sin(truth_rad-truth_mean_rad),cos(truth_rad-truth_mean_rad))

    data.frame(
      N_truth=nrow(.x),
      N_recovered=nrow(x),
      Coverage=nrow(x)/nrow(.x),
      MAE=mean(abs(err)),
      MedAE=median(abs(err)),
      RMSE=sqrt(mean(err^2)),
      R2=1-sum(err^2)/sum(truth_dev^2),
      R2_cosine=1-sum(1-cos(phase_diff_rad))/sum(1-cos(truth_dev_rad))
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Parameter="Phase")

native_parameter_metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  native_amplitude_metrics %>% dplyr::mutate(R2_cosine=NA_real_),
  native_phase_metrics
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Method=factor(Method,levels=native_method_order),
    Parameter=factor(Parameter,levels=c("Amplitude","Phase"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Parameter,Method)

print(native_parameter_metrics,n=Inf,width=Inf)

readr::write_tsv(
  native_parameter_metrics,
  file.path(native_output_dir,"native_parameter_recovery_complete_metrics.tsv")
)


```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
```

```{r}
## 1. ROC output directory

stopifnot(dir.exists(roc_output_dir))


## 2. Method order, labels and colors

method_order <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes",
  "CircaCompare",
  "HarmonicRegression",
  "dryR",
  "JTK"
)

method_labels <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes"="SRB",
  "CircaCompare"="CC",
  "HarmonicRegression"="HR",
  "dryR"="dryR",
  "JTK"="JTK"
)

ALG_COLORS <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes"="#C8D5B9",
  "CircaCompare"="#CDDCE5",
  "HarmonicRegression"="#FAF3DD",
  "dryR"="#F8DDDA",
  "JTK"="#E1D7D0"
)


## 3. Read saved ROC source data

roc_plot_df <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(
    roc_output_dir,
    "ROC_total_curve.tsv"
  ),
  show_col_types=FALSE
)

auc_df <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(
    roc_output_dir,
    "ROC_total_AUC.tsv"
  ),
  show_col_types=FALSE
)


## 4. Factor order

roc_plot_df <- roc_plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Method=factor(
      Method,
      levels=method_order
    )
  )

auc_df <- auc_df %>%
  mutate(
    Method=factor(
      Method,
      levels=method_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Method)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(roc_plot_df$Method),
  !anyNA(auc_df$Method)
)


## 5. Clean ROC coordinates for visualization only
## Duplicate FPR values are collapsed by keeping the maximum TPR.
## This dataframe is used only for plotting.
## AUC values remain those calculated from the original pROC objects.

roc_plot_clean <- roc_plot_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(FPR),
    is.finite(TPR)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Method,
    FPR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    TPR=max(
      TPR,
      na.rm=TRUE
    ),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Method,
    FPR
  )


## 6. Check ROC monotonicity

roc_monotonic_check <- roc_plot_clean %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n=dplyr::n(),
    n_TPR_decrease=sum(
      diff(TPR) < -1e-10,
      na.rm=TRUE
    ),
    min_TPR_change=min(
      diff(TPR),
      na.rm=TRUE
    ),
    .groups="drop"
  )

print(roc_monotonic_check)


## 7. Prepare legend labels

legend_labels <- setNames(
  sprintf(
    "%s: %.3f",
    method_labels[
      as.character(
        auc_df$Method
      )
    ],
    auc_df$AUC
  ),
  as.character(
    auc_df$Method
  )
)


## 8. Final ROC figure

p_roc <- ggplot(
  roc_plot_clean,
  aes(
    x=FPR,
    y=TPR,
    colour=Method,
    group=Method
  )
) +

  # A restrained neutral under-stroke keeps the supplied pale colours visible
  # on white without changing their exact method colour values.
  geom_step(
    data=roc_plot_clean %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Method!="scRhythmBayes"
      ),
    direction="vh",
    colour="#7A7A7A",
    linewidth=2.00,
    alpha=0.48
  ) +

  geom_step(
    data=roc_plot_clean %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Method=="scRhythmBayes"
      ),
    direction="vh",
    colour="#666666",
    linewidth=2.45,
    alpha=0.58
  ) +

  geom_step(
    data=roc_plot_clean %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Method!="scRhythmBayes"
      ),
    direction="vh",
    linewidth=1.30,
    alpha=1
  ) +

  geom_step(
    data=roc_plot_clean %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Method=="scRhythmBayes"
      ),
    direction="vh",
    linewidth=1.72,
    alpha=1
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values=ALG_COLORS,
    breaks=method_order,
    labels=legend_labels[
      method_order
    ],
    drop=FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks=c(
      0,
      0.05,
      0.10,
      0.15
    ),
    labels=c(
      "0",

  scale_y_continuous(

  labs(

  guides(

      )
    )
  ) +

  theme_figure3() +

  theme(
    text=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      face="bold"
    ),

    plot.title=element_text(
      size=28,
      face="bold",
      hjust=0.5,

        b=10
      )
    ),

    axis.title.x=element_text(

        t=8
      )
    ),

    axis.title.y=element_text(
```

# Part 8. Gene-level performance summary funkyheatmap

## 8.1 Assemble the audited performance matrix
```{r gene-performance-summary-assemble}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(funkyheatmap)
  library(patchwork)
})

gene_matrix_root <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output"

gene_matrix_output_dir <- file.path(
  gene_matrix_root,
  "GENE_BENCHMARK_SUMMARY",
  "FUNKYHEATMAP"
)

dir.create(
  gene_matrix_output_dir,
  recursive=TRUE,
  showWarnings=FALSE
)

gene_matrix_methods <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes",
  "CircaCompare",
  "HarmonicRegression",
  "dryR",
  "JTK"
)

# Keep the same method colours used throughout Figure 3.
gene_matrix_method_colors <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes"="#C8D5B9",
  "CircaCompare"="#CDDCE5",
  "HarmonicRegression"="#FAF3DD",
  "dryR"="#F8DDDA",
  "JTK"="#E1D7D0"
)

# Method input information matches the Figure 3 overview above. The input
# palette is deliberately separate from method colour and metric rank.
gene_matrix_input <- tibble(
  Method=gene_matrix_methods,
  Input_level=c(
    "Single-cell",
    "Pseudobulk",
    "Pseudobulk",
    "Pseudobulk",
    "Pseudobulk"
  ),
  Input_type=c(
    "Counts",
    "Normalised",
    "Normalised",
    "Counts",
    "Normalised"
  )
)

gene_matrix_input_colors <- c(
  "Single-cell"="#735C80",
  "Pseudobulk"="#BBAAC7"
)

readr::write_tsv(
  gene_matrix_input,
  file.path(
    gene_matrix_output_dir,
    "gene_level_performance_summary_input_metadata.tsv"
  )
)

gene_matrix_source_files <- c(
  AUC=file.path(
    gene_matrix_root,
    "ROC_TOTAL",
    "ROC_total_AUC.tsv"
  ),
  Detection=file.path(
    gene_matrix_root,
    "confusion_matrix",
    "CM_all_methods_metrics.tsv"
  ),
  Recovery=file.path(
    gene_matrix_root,
    "PARAMETER_RISK_COVERAGE",
    "native_parameter_recovery_complete_metrics.tsv"
  )
)

gene_matrix_missing_files <- gene_matrix_source_files[
  !file.exists(gene_matrix_source_files)
]

if (length(gene_matrix_missing_files)>0) {
  stop(
    "Missing saved gene-level benchmark result(s): ",
    paste(gene_matrix_missing_files, collapse=", ")
  )
}

gene_matrix_auc <- readr::read_tsv(
  gene_matrix_source_files[["AUC"]],
  show_col_types=FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    Method=as.character(Method),
    AUC=as.numeric(AUC)
  )

gene_matrix_detection_saved <- readr::read_tsv(
  gene_matrix_source_files[["Detection"]],
  show_col_types=FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Method=as.character(Method))

# Reconstruct the three displayed detection metrics from the saved counts.
# This is only an audit of the frozen benchmark table, not a new benchmark.
gene_matrix_detection <- gene_matrix_detection_saved %>%
  transmute(
    Method,
    Precision_from_counts=TP/(TP+FP),
    Recall_from_counts=TP/(TP+FN),
    F1_from_counts=2*TP/(2*TP+FP+FN),
    Precision_saved=as.numeric(Precision),
    Recall_saved=as.numeric(Recall),
    F1_saved=as.numeric(F1)
  )

stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    gene_matrix_detection$Precision_from_counts,
    gene_matrix_detection$Precision_saved,
    tolerance=1e-12
  )),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    gene_matrix_detection$Recall_from_counts,
    gene_matrix_detection$Recall_saved,
    tolerance=1e-12
  )),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    gene_matrix_detection$F1_from_counts,
    gene_matrix_detection$F1_saved,
    tolerance=1e-12
  ))
)

gene_matrix_recovery <- readr::read_tsv(
  gene_matrix_source_files[["Recovery"]],
  show_col_types=FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Method=as.character(Method),
    Parameter=as.character(Parameter)
  )

stopifnot(
  identical(sort(gene_matrix_auc$Method), sort(gene_matrix_methods)),
  identical(sort(gene_matrix_detection$Method), sort(gene_matrix_methods)),
  identical(
    sort(unique(gene_matrix_recovery$Method)),
    sort(gene_matrix_methods)
  ),
  all(c("Amplitude", "Phase") %in% gene_matrix_recovery$Parameter)
)

# The frozen recovery table uses one common coverage denominator for amplitude
# and phase. Show it once as a dedicated bar column while retaining both
# source rows in the audit table below.
gene_matrix_coverage_check <- gene_matrix_recovery %>%
  select(Method, Parameter, Coverage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from=Parameter,
    values_from=Coverage
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Method, gene_matrix_methods))

stopifnot(
  identical(gene_matrix_coverage_check$Method, gene_matrix_methods),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    gene_matrix_coverage_check$Amplitude,
    gene_matrix_coverage_check$Phase,
    tolerance=1e-12
  ))
)

gene_matrix_raw <- bind_rows(
  gene_matrix_auc %>%
    transmute(
      Method,
      Metric="AUC",
      Raw_value=AUC,
      Direction="higher",
      Metric_family="Detection",
      Metric_order=1L,
      Metric_id="det_auc"
    ),
  gene_matrix_detection %>%
    transmute(
      Method,
      Precision=Precision_from_counts,
      Recall=Recall_from_counts,
      F1=F1_from_counts
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols=c(Precision, Recall, F1),
      names_to="Metric",
      values_to="Raw_value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction="higher",
      Metric_family="Detection",
      Metric_order=match(Metric, c("Precision", "Recall", "F1"))+1L,
      Metric_id=paste0("det_", tolower(Metric))
    ),
  gene_matrix_recovery %>%
    filter(Parameter=="Amplitude") %>%
    transmute(
      Method,
      Coverage=as.numeric(Coverage),
      MAE=as.numeric(MAE),
      RMSE=as.numeric(RMSE),
      `R²`=as.numeric(R2)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols=c(Coverage, MAE, RMSE, `R²`),
      names_to="Metric",
      values_to="Raw_value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction=if_else(Metric %in% c("MAE", "RMSE"), "lower", "higher"),
      Metric_family="Amplitude recovery",
      Metric_order=match(Metric, c("Coverage", "MAE", "RMSE", "R²")),
      Metric_id=c(
        Coverage="amp_coverage",
        MAE="amp_mae",
        RMSE="amp_rmse",
        `R²`="amp_r2"
      )[Metric]
    ),
  gene_matrix_recovery %>%
    filter(Parameter=="Phase") %>%
    transmute(
      Method,
      Coverage=as.numeric(Coverage),
      MAE=as.numeric(MAE),
      RMSE=as.numeric(RMSE),
      `Circular R²`=as.numeric(R2_cosine)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols=c(Coverage, MAE, RMSE, `Circular R²`),
      names_to="Metric",
      values_to="Raw_value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction=if_else(Metric %in% c("MAE", "RMSE"), "lower", "higher"),
      Metric_family="Phase recovery",
      Metric_order=match(
        Metric,
        c("Coverage", "MAE", "RMSE", "Circular R²")
      ),
      Metric_id=c(
        Coverage="phase_coverage",
        MAE="phase_mae",
        RMSE="phase_rmse",
        `Circular R²`="phase_r2"
      )[Metric]
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Method=as.character(Method),
    Metric=as.character(Metric),
    Metric_family=as.character(Metric_family),
    Direction=as.character(Direction),
    Metric_id=as.character(Metric_id)
  )

gene_matrix_family_order <- c(
  "Detection",
  "Amplitude recovery",
  "Phase recovery"
)

# Higher/lower direction is used only for within-metric ranking.
# Raw_value is never rescaled and is displayed directly in the matrix.
gene_matrix_audit <- gene_matrix_raw %>%
  group_by(Metric_id) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank=dense_rank(
      if_else(Direction=="higher", -Raw_value, Raw_value)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(
    match(Metric_family, gene_matrix_family_order),
    Metric_order,
    match(Method, gene_matrix_methods)
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(gene_matrix_audit)==length(gene_matrix_methods)*12L,
  all(table(gene_matrix_audit$Metric_id)==length(gene_matrix_methods)),
  all(is.finite(gene_matrix_audit$Raw_value)),
  all(gene_matrix_audit$Direction %in% c("higher", "lower")),
  all(gene_matrix_audit$Rank %in% seq_along(gene_matrix_methods)),
  "phase_coverage" %in% gene_matrix_audit$Metric_id
)

readr::write_tsv(
  gene_matrix_audit %>%
    select(
      Method,
      Metric_family,
      Metric,
      Metric_id,
      Raw_value,
      Direction,
      Rank
    ),
  file.path(
    gene_matrix_output_dir,
    "gene_level_performance_summary_metric_audit.tsv"
  )
)

gene_matrix_source_manifest <- tibble(
  Metric_block=c(
    "Detection: AUC",
    "Detection: Precision, Recall and F1",
    "Amplitude and phase recovery"
  ),
  Source=unname(gene_matrix_source_files),
  Use=c(
    "Frozen AUC values",
    "Frozen TP, FP and FN counts; displayed metrics verified from counts",
    "Frozen native coverage and recovery metrics"
  )
)

readr::write_tsv(
  gene_matrix_source_manifest,
  file.path(
    gene_matrix_output_dir,
    "gene_level_performance_summary_source_manifest.tsv"
  )
)

print(
  gene_matrix_audit %>%
    select(
      Method,
      Metric_family,
      Metric,
      Raw_value,
      Direction,
      Rank
    ),
  n=Inf
)
```

## 8.2 Fixed-size metric circles and funkyheatmap assembly
```{r gene-performance-summary-funkyheatmap, fig.width=14.5, fig.height=6.25}
# Neutral rank tones are distinct from the method and input-level colours.
# Raw values remain the primary labels; rank is explicitly keyed below.
gene_matrix_rank_palette <- c(
  "1"="#84929A",
  "2"="#A5B0B6",
  "3"="#C2CACE",
  "4"="#DBE0E2",
  "5"="#F0F2F2"
)

gene_matrix_plot_data <- gene_matrix_audit %>%
  mutate(
    # A fixed circle size keeps the raw number clear and leaves only one
    # performance encoding: the separately keyed within-metric rank.
    Point_size_score=0.96,
    Rank_value=as.character(Rank),
    Rank_color=unname(
      gene_matrix_rank_palette[Rank_value]
    ),
    Raw_label=if_else(
      is.finite(Raw_value),
      sprintf("%.3f", Raw_value),
      "NA"
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  all(gene_matrix_plot_data$Point_size_score==0.96),
  !anyNA(gene_matrix_plot_data$Rank_color)
)

readr::write_tsv(
  gene_matrix_plot_data %>%
    select(
      Method,
      Metric_family,
      Metric,

      Raw_label,

      Rank,

)

gene_matrix_metric_definition <- gene_matrix_audit %>%

  distinct(
    Metric_family,

    match(Metric_family, gene_matrix_family_order),
    Metric_order
  )

gene_matrix_wide <- gene_matrix_plot_data %>%
  select(
    Method,
    Metric_id,
    Raw_value,
    Rank_value,
    Point_size_score,
    Raw_label

    id_cols=Method,

      Raw_value,
      Rank_value,
      Point_size_score,
      Raw_label
    ),
    names_glue="{Metric_id}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Method, gene_matrix_methods)) %>%

    input_swatch_score,
    Coverage_score,
    Coverage_label,
    Coverage_bar_colour,
    everything()
  )

stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    gene_matrix_wide$Coverage_score,
    gene_matrix_wide$phase_coverage_Raw_value
  )),
  !anyNA(gene_matrix_wide$Input_level),

)

gene_matrix_method_column_info <- bind_rows(

    geom="text",
    group="Coverage",
    palette=NA_character_,
    id_color=NA_character_,
    id_size=NA_character_,
    width=1.10,
    overlay=FALSE,
    legend=FALSE,
    size=4.05,
    fontface="bold",
    hjust=0.5
  )
)

gene_matrix_metric_column_info <- bind_rows(lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(gene_matrix_metric_definition)),
  function(i) {
    one_metric <- gene_matrix_metric_definition[i, ]

    circle_id <- paste0(
      one_metric$Metric_id,
      "_Raw_value"
    )

    rank_id <- paste0(
      one_metric$Metric_id,
      "_Rank_value"
    )

    size_id <- paste0(
      one_metric$Metric_id,
      "_Point_size_score"
    )

    label_id <- paste0(
      one_metric$Metric_id,
      "_Raw_label"
    )

    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        id=circle_id,
        name=if_else(
          one_metric$Metric=="Circular R²",
          "Circ. R²",
          one_metric$Metric
        ),
        geom="circle",
        group=one_metric$Metric_family,
        palette="performance_rank",
        id_color=rank_id,
        id_size=size_id,
        width=1.27,
        overlay=FALSE,
        legend=FALSE,
        size=NA_real_,
        fontface=NA_character_,
        hjust=NA_real_
      ),
      tibble(
        id=label_id,
        name="",
        geom="text",
        group=one_metric$Metric_family,
        palette="raw_text",
        id_color=rank_id,
        id_size=NA_character_,
        width=1.27,
        overlay=TRUE,
        legend=FALSE,
        size=3.80,
        fontface="bold",
        hjust=0.5
      )
    )
  }
))

gene_matrix_column_info <- bind_rows(
  gene_matrix_method_column_info,
  gene_matrix_input_column_info,
  gene_matrix_coverage_column_info,
  gene_matrix_metric_column_info
)

gene_matrix_column_groups <- tribble(
  ~level1, ~group, ~palette,
  "Method", "Method", "method_group",
  "Input", "Input", "input_group",
  "Coverage", "Coverage", "coverage_group",
  "Detection", "Detection", "detection_group",
  "Amplitude recovery", "Amplitude recovery", "amplitude_group",
  "Phase recovery", "Phase recovery", "phase_group"
)

gene_matrix_row_info <- tibble(
  id=gene_matrix_wide$id,
  group=NA_character_
)

gene_matrix_palettes <- list(
  method_group=c(
    "#161616",
    "#161616"
  ),
  input_group=c(
    "#735C80",
    "#735C80"
  ),
  coverage_group=c(
    "#65747B",
    "#65747B"
  ),
  detection_group=c(
    "#74836B",
    "#74836B"
  ),
  amplitude_group=c(
    "#6D7E89",
    "#6D7E89"
  ),
  phase_group=c(
    "#8F7771",
    "#8F7771"
  ),
  method_color=gene_matrix_method_colors,
  input_level=gene_matrix_input_colors,
  coverage_bar=c("Coverage"="#AAB8BE"),
  performance_rank=gene_matrix_rank_palette,
  raw_text=c(
    "1"="#1B1B1B",
    "2"="#1B1B1B",
    "3"="#1B1B1B",
    "4"="#1B1B1B",
    "5"="#1B1B1B"
  )
)

p_gene_performance_summary <- funkyheatmap::funky_heatmap(
  data=gene_matrix_wide,
  column_info=gene_matrix_column_info,
  column_groups=gene_matrix_column_groups,
  row_info=gene_matrix_row_info,
  palettes=gene_matrix_palettes,
  legends=list(
    list(
      palette="method_color",
      enabled=FALSE
    ),
    list(
      palette="input_level",
      enabled=FALSE
    ),
    list(
      palette="coverage_bar",
      enabled=FALSE
    ),
    list(
      palette="performance_rank",
      title="Rank (1 best, 5 worst)",
      geom="rect",
      labels=as.character(1:5),
      size=rep(1, 5),
      color=unname(gene_matrix_rank_palette),
      enabled=TRUE
    ),
    list(
      palette="raw_text",
      enabled=FALSE
    )
  ),
  position_args=funkyheatmap::position_arguments(
    row_height=1,
    row_space=0.14,
    row_bigspace=0.25,
    col_width=1.08,
    col_space=0.14,
    col_bigspace=0.25,
    col_annot_offset=1.20,
    col_annot_angle=32,
    expand_xmin=0.02,
    expand_xmax=1.10,
    expand_ymin=0.10,
    expand_ymax=0.02
  ),
  scale_column=FALSE,
  add_abc=FALSE
)

# Remove the default alternating grey row bands from the main plot. When the
# rank key is enabled, funkyheatmap returns a patchwork and nests that plot.
gene_matrix_main_plot <- p_gene_performance_summary$patches$plots[[1]]

gene_matrix_zebra_layers <- which(vapply(
  gene_matrix_main_plot$layers,
  function(one_layer) {
    identical(one_layer$aes_params$fill, "#DDDDDD")
  },
  logical(1)
))

if (length(gene_matrix_zebra_layers)>0) {
  gene_matrix_main_plot$layers <-
    gene_matrix_main_plot$layers[-gene_matrix_zebra_layers]
  p_gene_performance_summary$patches$plots[[1]] <- gene_matrix_main_plot
}

# funkyheatmap 0.5.2 places the categorical legend numbers against the
# lower PDF edge. Lift those five labels slightly without changing the data.
gene_matrix_rank_legend <- p_gene_performance_summary$patches$plots[[3]]
gene_matrix_legend_text_layer <- which(vapply(
  gene_matrix_rank_legend$layers,
  function(one_layer) inherits(one_layer$geom, "GeomText"),
  logical(1)
))

stopifnot(length(gene_matrix_legend_text_layer)==1L)

gene_matrix_legend_text <- gene_matrix_rank_legend$layers[[
  gene_matrix_legend_text_layer
]]$data

gene_matrix_rank_labels <- gene_matrix_legend_text$label_value %in%
  as.character(1:5)

stopifnot(sum(gene_matrix_rank_labels)==5L)

gene_matrix_legend_text$ymin[gene_matrix_rank_labels] <- -3.20
gene_matrix_legend_text$ymax[gene_matrix_rank_labels] <- -3.20
gene_matrix_rank_legend$layers[[gene_matrix_legend_text_layer]]$data <-
  gene_matrix_legend_text
gene_matrix_rank_legend <- gene_matrix_rank_legend +
  ggplot2::expand_limits(y=-3.75)
p_gene_performance_summary$patches$plots[[3]] <-
  gene_matrix_rank_legend

p_gene_performance_summary <- p_gene_performance_summary +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title="A  Gene-level performance summary",
    theme=theme(
      text=element_text(
        family="Arial",
        colour="#20242A"
      ),
      plot.title=element_text(
        size=30,
        face="bold",
        hjust=0
      ),
      plot.subtitle=element_blank(),
      plot.background=element_rect(
        fill="white",
        colour=NA
      ),
      plot.margin=margin(
        t=7,
        r=4,
        b=1,
        l=4
      )
    )
  ) &
  theme(
    text=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=17,
      colour="#20242A"
    ),
    plot.background=element_rect(
      fill="white",
      colour=NA
    ),
    panel.background=element_rect(
      fill="white",
      colour=NA
    )
  )

print(p_gene_performance_summary)
```

# Part 9. SRB-specific circadian expression heatmap

## 9.1 Reload the frozen overall profile and peak-time order
```{r srb-specific-heatmap-data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(RColorBrewer)
})

srb_heatmap_dir <- file.path(
  "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output",
  "SRB_SPECIFIC_HEATMAP"
)

# This is the frozen overall profile used by the earlier single-panel figure.
# It combines both benchmark conditions before smoothing and preserves the
# original peak-time ordering of the 56 SRB-specific rhythmic genes.
srb_heatmap_source <- file.path(
  srb_heatmap_dir,
  "SRB_specific_56genes_overall_smoothed_expression.tsv"
)

srb_heatmap_order_source <- file.path(
  srb_heatmap_dir,
  "SRB_specific_56genes_overall_peak_rank.tsv"
)

stopifnot(
  file.exists(srb_heatmap_source),
  file.exists(srb_heatmap_order_source)
)

srb_heatmap_expression <- readr::read_tsv(
  srb_heatmap_source,
  show_col_types=FALSE
)

srb_heatmap_order <- readr::read_tsv(
  srb_heatmap_order_source,
  show_col_types=FALSE
)

srb_heatmap_genes <- as.character(srb_heatmap_order$gene)
srb_heatmap_times <- seq(0, 23.75, by=0.25)

stopifnot(
  length(srb_heatmap_genes)==56L,
  !anyDuplicated(srb_heatmap_genes),
  identical(sort(unique(srb_heatmap_expression$gene)),
            sort(srb_heatmap_genes)),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    sort(unique(srb_heatmap_expression$Time)),
    srb_heatmap_times
  )),
  nrow(srb_heatmap_expression)==56L*96L,
  all(is.finite(srb_heatmap_expression$Row_Z)),
  all(table(srb_heatmap_expression$gene)==96L)
)

srb_heatmap_plot_data <- srb_heatmap_expression %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_y=57L-match(gene, srb_heatmap_genes),
    Time_center=Time+0.125
  )

stopifnot(
  all(srb_heatmap_plot_data$Gene_y %in% seq_len(56L))
)

# Restore the original ZT8-ZT20 light interval. The photoperiod annotation
# uses the established Figure 3 pastel colours and remains independent from
# the continuous expression palette.
srb_heatmap_periods <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Period, ~xmin, ~xmax, ~Label_x, ~Fill,
  "Night",  0,  8,  4, "#CDDCE5",
  "Day",    8, 20, 14, "#FAF3DD",
  "Night", 20, 24, 22, "#CDDCE5"
)

readr::write_tsv(
  tibble::tibble(
    Source=c(srb_heatmap_source, srb_heatmap_order_source),
    Use=c(
      "Frozen overall smoothed Row Z-score",
      "Frozen overall peak-time gene order"
    )
  ),
  file.path(
    srb_heatmap_dir,
    "SRB_specific_56genes_overall_heatmap_source_manifest.tsv"
  )
)
```

## 9.2 Plot and export the restored single-panel heatmap
```{r srb-specific-heatmap-plot, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=13.5}
# RColorBrewer RdBu gives an official, symmetric diverging scale. Red denotes
# expression above the gene-wise mean, white the mean, and blue below it.
srb_heatmap_expression_colors <- rev(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")
)

p_srb_specific_circadian <- ggplot(
  srb_heatmap_plot_data,
  aes(x=Time_center, y=Gene_y, fill=Row_Z)
) +
  geom_tile(
    width=0.25,
    height=1,
    colour=NA
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data=srb_heatmap_periods,
    aes(xmin=xmin, xmax=xmax, ymin=57.00, ymax=58.45),
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    fill=srb_heatmap_periods$Fill,
    colour=NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data=srb_heatmap_periods,
    aes(x=Label_x, y=57.72, label=Period),
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    family="Arial",
    fontface="bold",
    size=6.2,
    colour="#20242A"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours=srb_heatmap_expression_colors,
    limits=c(-1.5, 1.5),
    oob=scales::squish,
    breaks=c(-1.5, 0, 1.5),
    name="Row Z-score"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks=seq(0, 20, by=4),
    labels=paste0("ZT", seq(0, 20, by=4)),
    limits=c(-0.25, 24.25),
    expand=c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks=56:1,
    labels=srb_heatmap_genes,
    limits=c(0.5, 58.70),
    position="right",
    expand=c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title="SRB-specific rhythmic genes",
    x=NULL,
    y=NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill=guide_colorbar(
      title.position="top",
      title.hjust=0.5,
      barheight=grid::unit(2.25, "in"),
      barwidth=grid::unit(0.36, "in"),
      ticks.colour="white",
      frame.colour=NA
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size=18, base_family="Arial") +
  theme(
    text=element_text(family="Arial", colour="#20242A"),
    plot.title=element_text(
      family="Arial",
      size=28,
      face="bold",
      hjust=0.5,
      margin=margin(b=14)
    ),
    plot.subtitle=element_blank(),
    axis.text.x=element_text(size=18, face="bold"),
    axis.text.y=element_text(size=12.5, face="plain"),
    axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
    axis.line.y=element_blank(),
    axis.line.x=element_line(linewidth=0.45, colour="#20242A"),
    legend.position="right",
    legend.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold"),
    legend.text=element_text(size=16),
    panel.grid=element_blank(),
    plot.background=element_rect(fill="white", colour=NA),
    plot.margin=margin(12, 20, 12, 18)
  )

if (interactive()) {
  print(p_srb_specific_circadian)
}

srb_heatmap_png <- file.path(
  srb_heatmap_dir,
  "SRB_specific_56genes_overall_circadian_heatmap_restyled.png"
)

srb_heatmap_pdf <- file.path(
  srb_heatmap_dir,
  "SRB_specific_56genes_overall_circadian_heatmap_restyled.pdf"
)

srb_heatmap_svg <- file.path(
  srb_heatmap_dir,
  "SRB_specific_56genes_overall_circadian_heatmap_restyled.svg"
)

ggsave(
  filename=srb_heatmap_png,
  plot=p_srb_specific_circadian,
  width=10.5,
  height=13.5,
  dpi=600,
  bg="white"
)

grDevices::quartz(
  file=srb_heatmap_pdf,
  type="pdf",
  width=10.5,
  height=13.5,
  family="Arial"
)
print(p_srb_specific_circadian)
grDevices::dev.off()

svglite::svglite(
  file=srb_heatmap_svg,
  width=10.5,
  height=13.5,
  bg="white"
)
print(p_srb_specific_circadian)
grDevices::dev.off()

stopifnot(
  all(file.exists(c(srb_heatmap_png,
                    srb_heatmap_pdf,
                    srb_heatmap_svg))),
  all(file.info(c(srb_heatmap_png,
```

## 9.3 Superseded Plotly Row-Z surface retained for audit
```{r srb-specific-temporal-surface-data, eval=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(plotly)
  library(htmlwidgets)
  library(webshot2)
})

# Reuse the exact Part 9 Row_Z values and frozen peak-time gene order. The
# input profile is already the 15-minute smoothed overall profile, so this
# section performs no additional interpolation or visual smoothing.
srb_surface_wide <- srb_heatmap_expression %>%
  mutate(
    gene=factor(gene, levels=srb_heatmap_genes)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Time, gene) %>%
  select(Time, gene, Row_Z) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from=gene,
    values_from=Row_Z
  ) %>%
  arrange(Time)

srb_surface_times <- as.numeric(srb_surface_wide$Time)
srb_surface_genes <- srb_heatmap_genes
srb_surface_gene_index <- seq_along(srb_surface_genes)
srb_surface_expression_matrix <- as.matrix(
  srb_surface_wide[, srb_surface_genes]
)

srb_surface_peak_phase <- setNames(
  srb_heatmap_order$Peak_time,
  srb_heatmap_order$gene
)[srb_surface_genes]

stopifnot(
  identical(srb_surface_times, srb_heatmap_times),
  identical(colnames(srb_surface_expression_matrix),
            srb_surface_genes),
  identical(dim(srb_surface_expression_matrix), c(96L, 56L)),
  all(is.finite(srb_surface_expression_matrix)),
  all(diff(srb_surface_peak_phase)>=0)
)

# Put the heatmap projection just below the observed Row_Z range. The main
# surface keeps the original values; no clipping is applied to its geometry.
srb_surface_z_floor <- floor(
  4*(min(srb_surface_expression_matrix)-0.25)
)/4

srb_surface_floor_matrix <- matrix(
  srb_surface_z_floor,
  nrow=nrow(srb_surface_expression_matrix),
  ncol=ncol(srb_surface_expression_matrix)
)

# Teal--cream--orange diverging scale. The midpoint is exactly Row_Z=0 and
# the +/-1.5 colour limits match the Part 9 heatmap contract.
srb_surface_color_scale <- list(
  c(0.00, "#1F7775"),
  c(0.25, "#79B8AD"),
  c(0.50, "#FAF3DD"),
  c(0.75, "#F0B46E"),
  c(1.00, "#D8742A")
)

srb_surface_color_limits <- c(-1.5, 1.5)
srb_surface_tick_index <- seq(
  1L,
  length(srb_surface_genes),
  by=5L
)

# Matrix order follows Plotly's z rows (time) and columns (gene rank).
srb_surface_hover <- matrix(
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "Gene: %s<br>",
      "Peak phase: ZT%.2f<br>",
      "Circadian time: ZT%.2f<br>",
      "Row Z-score: %.2f"
    ),
    rep(srb_surface_genes, each=length(srb_surface_times)),
    rep(srb_surface_peak_phase, each=length(srb_surface_times)),
    rep(srb_surface_times, times=length(srb_surface_genes)),
    as.vector(srb_surface_expression_matrix)
  ),
  nrow=length(srb_surface_times),
  ncol=length(srb_surface_genes)
)

srb_surface_source_manifest <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Object, ~Use,
  "srb_heatmap_expression$Row_Z",
  "Z geometry and surface/projection colour",
  "srb_heatmap_genes",
  "X-axis gene order frozen by overall peak phase",
  "srb_heatmap_expression$Time",
  "Y-axis circadian time (ZT hours)",
  "srb_heatmap_order$Peak_time",
  "Peak-phase annotation and order validation"
)

readr::write_tsv(
  srb_surface_source_manifest,
  file.path(
    srb_heatmap_dir,
    "SRB_specific_56genes_temporal_surface3D_source_manifest.tsv"
  )
)

srb_surface_visual_contract <- tibble::tibble(
  Feature=c(
    "X axis",
    "Y axis",
    "Z axis",
    "Projection",
    "Condition handling",
    "Smoothing",
    "Colour scale",
    "Camera"
  ),
  Definition=c(
    "56 SRB-specific genes ordered by frozen overall peak phase",
    "Circadian time from ZT0 to ZT23.75 in 0.25-hour steps",
    "Original Part 9 gene-wise Row_Z scaled expression",
    sprintf("Same Row_Z matrix at constant z-floor %.2f", srb_surface_z_floor),
    paste0(
      "Single overall Part 9 profile; the plotting layer contains no ",
      "condition axis and creates no cross-condition connection"
    ),
    paste0(
      "No additional smoothing; reuse the frozen Part 9 15-minute ",
      "profile as stored"
    ),
    "Teal--cream--orange diverging scale centred at Row_Z=0",
    "Fixed oblique view shared by the interactive and static exports"
  )
)

readr::write_tsv(
  srb_surface_visual_contract,
  file.path(
    srb_heatmap_dir,
    "SRB_specific_56genes_temporal_surface3D_visual_contract.tsv"
  )
)
```

```{r srb-specific-temporal-surface-plot, fig.width=15, fig.height=10, eval=FALSE}
srb_surface_camera <- list(
  eye=list(x=1.45, y=-1.55, z=1.05),
  center=list(x=0, y=0, z=-0.08),
  up=list(x=0, y=0, z=1)
)

p_srb_specific_temporal_3d <- plotly::plot_ly(
  width=1800,
  height=1200
) %>%
  # Add the z-floor first so the main surface remains visually dominant.
  plotly::add_surface(
    x=srb_surface_gene_index,
    y=srb_surface_times,
    z=srb_surface_floor_matrix,
    surfacecolor=srb_surface_expression_matrix,
    colorscale=srb_surface_color_scale,
    cmin=srb_surface_color_limits[1],
    cmax=srb_surface_color_limits[2],
    showscale=FALSE,
    opacity=0.96,
    hoverinfo="skip",
    lighting=list(
      ambient=1,
      diffuse=0,
      specular=0,
      roughness=1,
      fresnel=0
    ),
    name="Heatmap projection"
  ) %>%
  plotly::add_surface(
    x=srb_surface_gene_index,
    y=srb_surface_times,
    z=srb_surface_expression_matrix,
    surfacecolor=srb_surface_expression_matrix,
    colorscale=srb_surface_color_scale,
    cmin=srb_surface_color_limits[1],
    cmax=srb_surface_color_limits[2],
    showscale=TRUE,
    text=srb_surface_hover,
    hovertemplate="%{text}<extra></extra>",
    contours=list(
      x=list(show=FALSE),
      y=list(show=FALSE),
      z=list(show=FALSE)

# Reuse a bundled Pandoc when a terminal R session cannot discover it. If no
# Pandoc is available, saveWidget falls back to a standard HTML dependency
# directory rather than changing the figure or blocking the static export.
if (!nzchar(Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO_PANDOC"))) {
  srb_surface_pandoc_candidates <- c(
    "/Applications/RStudio.app/Contents/Resources/app/quarto/bin/tools/aarch64",
    "/Applications/RStudio.app/Contents/Resources/app/quarto/bin/tools/x86_64",
    "/Applications/Positron.app/Contents/Resources/app/quarto/bin/tools/aarch64",
    "/Applications/Positron.app/Contents/Resources/app/quarto/bin/tools/x86_64"
  )
  srb_surface_pandoc_candidates <- srb_surface_pandoc_candidates[
    file.exists(file.path(srb_surface_pandoc_candidates, "pandoc"))
  ]
  if (length(srb_surface_pandoc_candidates)>0L) {
    Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO_PANDOC=srb_surface_pandoc_candidates[1])

}

)

# WebGL is rasterized in static outputs. Wrap the verified 15:10 PNG in a
# matching landscape PDF so the complete scene and colour bar are retained;
# the interactive HTML remains the authoritative, rotatable version.
srb_surface_pdf_ok <- tryCatch({
  srb_surface_png_raster <- png::readPNG(srb_surface_png)
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(
    filename=srb_surface_pdf,
    width=15,
    height=10,
    bg="white",
    family="Arial"
  )
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.raster(
    srb_surface_png_raster,
    width=grid::unit(1, "npc"),
    height=grid::unit(1, "npc"),
    interpolate=TRUE
  )
  grDevices::dev.off()
  file.exists(srb_surface_pdf) && file.info(srb_surface_pdf)$size>0
}, error=function(e) {
  message("Static Plotly PDF export unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e))
  FALSE
})

if (!srb_surface_pdf_ok && file.exists(srb_surface_pdf)) {
  file.remove(srb_surface_pdf)
}

srb_surface_output_inventory <- tibble::tibble(
  Format=c(

  ),

    srb_surface_png,
    if (srb_surface_pdf_ok) srb_surface_pdf else character()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Exists=file.exists(Path),
    Bytes=file.info(Path)$size
  )

stopifnot(

)
```

## 9.4 Origin-style 3D expression surface with floor projection
```{r srb-specific-plot3d-data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(plot3D)
  library(ragg)
})

# Origin's input is a rectangular gene x time matrix. Use the same frozen
# 15-minute Part 9 profile, but take the unscaled Smoothed values rather than
# Row_Z. No new interpolation or smoothing is introduced here.
srb_plot3d_raw_wide <- srb_heatmap_expression %>%
  mutate(
    gene=factor(gene, levels=srb_heatmap_genes)
  ) %>%
  select(gene, Time, Smoothed) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from=Time,
    values_from=Smoothed
  ) %>%
  arrange(gene)

srb_plot3d_genes <- as.character(srb_plot3d_raw_wide$gene)
srb_plot3d_times <- srb_heatmap_times
srb_plot3d_raw_matrix <- as.matrix(
  srb_plot3d_raw_wide[, -1]
)

rownames(srb_plot3d_raw_matrix) <- srb_plot3d_genes
colnames(srb_plot3d_raw_matrix) <- sprintf(
  "ZT%.2f",
  srb_plot3d_times
)

stopifnot(
  identical(srb_plot3d_genes, srb_heatmap_genes),
  identical(dim(srb_plot3d_raw_matrix), c(56L, 96L)),
  all(is.finite(srb_plot3d_raw_matrix))
)

# Absolute expression can be selected for a literal raw-height rendering, but
# its large between-gene baseline differences obscure the circadian signal.
# The default subtracts only each gene's mean: it does not divide by the SD,
# does not force equal amplitudes, and therefore is not row scaling.
srb_plot3d_value_mode <- "mean_centered_unscaled"
# srb_plot3d_value_mode <- "raw_absolute"

srb_plot3d_expression_matrix <- switch(
  srb_plot3d_value_mode,
  raw_absolute=srb_plot3d_raw_matrix,
  mean_centered_unscaled=sweep(
    srb_plot3d_raw_matrix,
    1,
    rowMeans(srb_plot3d_raw_matrix),
    FUN="-"
  ),
  stop("Unknown srb_plot3d_value_mode: ", srb_plot3d_value_mode)
)

if (identical(srb_plot3d_value_mode, "mean_centered_unscaled")) {
  stopifnot(
    max(abs(rowMeans(srb_plot3d_expression_matrix)))<1e-12
  )
}

srb_plot3d_range <- range(
  srb_plot3d_expression_matrix,
  finite=TRUE
)
srb_plot3d_span <- diff(srb_plot3d_range)
srb_plot3d_z_floor <- srb_plot3d_range[1]-0.95*srb_plot3d_span
srb_plot3d_z_top <- srb_plot3d_range[2]+0.10*srb_plot3d_span

# Approximate Origin's BlueOrange palette: dark teal/cyan at the low end,
# a pale cream midpoint, and saturated orange/brown at the high end.
srb_plot3d_blue_orange <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c(
    "#057B75",
    "#20BDB2",
    "#A7DED1",
    "#F6F2C8",
    "#FDB25B",
    "#EF741F",
    "#983D06"
  ),
  space="Lab"
)(160)

srb_plot3d_color_limits <- if (
  identical(srb_plot3d_value_mode, "mean_centered_unscaled")
) {
  max_abs <- max(abs(srb_plot3d_expression_matrix))
  c(-max_abs, max_abs)
} else {
  srb_plot3d_range
}

# Save the exact Origin-style matrices: one gene identifier column followed by
# one column per circadian-time point.
srb_plot3d_raw_source <- tibble::as_tibble(
  srb_plot3d_raw_matrix,
  rownames="gene"
)

srb_plot3d_centered_source <- tibble::as_tibble(
  sweep(
    srb_plot3d_raw_matrix,
    1,
    rowMeans(srb_plot3d_raw_matrix),
    FUN="-"
  ),
  rownames="gene"
)

srb_plot3d_raw_source_file <- file.path(
  srb_heatmap_dir,
  "SRB_specific_56genes_surface3D_matrix_raw_smoothed.tsv"
)

srb_plot3d_centered_source_file <- file.path(
  srb_heatmap_dir,
  "SRB_specific_56genes_surface3D_matrix_mean_centered_unscaled.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(
  srb_plot3d_raw_source,
  srb_plot3d_raw_source_file
)

readr::write_tsv(
  srb_plot3d_centered_source,
  srb_plot3d_centered_source_file
)

srb_plot3d_visual_contract <- tibble::tibble(
  Feature=c(
    "Input matrix",
    "Value mode",
    "X axis",
    "Y axis",
    "Z axis",
    "Floor projection",
    "Smoothing",
    "Colour palette",
    "Condition handling"
  ),
  Definition=c(
    "56 genes x 96 circadian-time points; gene ID in the first column",
    paste0(
      srb_plot3d_value_mode,
      "; subtract gene mean only; no division by gene SD"
    ),
    "Gene rank in the frozen overall peak-phase order",
    "Circadian time from ZT0 to ZT23.75",
    "Unscaled expression deviation from each gene mean",
    sprintf(
      "Same expression matrix projected at z=%.5f",
      srb_plot3d_z_floor
    ),
    "No new smoothing; reuse the frozen Part 9 Smoothed profile",
    "Origin-inspired BlueOrange: teal--cream--orange",
    paste0(
      "Single frozen overall Part 9 profile; no condition axis and no ",
      "cross-condition interpolation in this plotting layer"
    )
  )
)

readr::write_tsv(
  srb_plot3d_visual_contract,
  file.path(
    srb_heatmap_dir,
    "SRB_specific_56genes_surface3D_plot3D_visual_contract.tsv"
  )
)
```

```{r srb-specific-plot3d-render, fig.width=13, fig.height=9.5}
srb_plot3d_draw <- function() {
  old_par <- graphics::par(
    mar=c(1.5, 3.2, 2.7, 6.1),
    family="Arial",
    fg="#20242A",
    col.axis="#20242A",
    col.lab="#20242A",
    col.main="#20242A"
  )
  on.exit(graphics::par(old_par), add=TRUE)

  plot3D::persp3D(
    x=seq_len(nrow(srb_plot3d_expression_matrix)),
    y=srb_plot3d_times,
    z=srb_plot3d_expression_matrix,
    colvar=srb_plot3d_expression_matrix,
    col=srb_plot3d_blue_orange,
    clim=srb_plot3d_color_limits,
    zlim=c(srb_plot3d_z_floor, srb_plot3d_z_top),
    image=list(
      side="zmin",
      col=srb_plot3d_blue_orange,
      border=NA
    ),
    theta=38,
    phi=24,
    expand=0.72,
    d=1.8,
    r=sqrt(3),
    scale=TRUE,
    xlab="Gene rank by peak phase",
    ylab="Circadian time (ZT, h)",
    zlab="Expression deviation",
    main="SRB-specific rhythmic genes",
    colkey=list(
      side=4,
      length=0.52,
      width=0.58,
      dist=0.08,
      cex.axis=0.80,
      cex.clab=0.88,
      line.clab=1.0
    ),
    clab="Expression deviation",
    facets=TRUE,
    border=NA,
    lighting=FALSE,
    shade=0.18,
    ltheta=-120,
    lphi=35,
    bty="b2",
    ticktype="detailed",
    nticks=6,
    col.panel="#FFFFFF",
    col.grid="#D5DAD8",
    lwd.grid=0.65,
    cex.axis=0.74,
    cex.lab=0.90,
    cex.main=1.18
  )

  graphics::mtext(
    "Mean-centered only; no variance scaling | light interval ZT8-ZT20",
    side=3,
    line=0.15,
    cex=0.75,
    col="#4B514F"
  )
}
```

# Part 10. Module-level benchmark and Figure 3F-I

## 10.1 Read results and run infer_rhythm_module
```{r module-results}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggforce)
  library(patchwork)
  library(mvtnorm)
  library(ragg)
})

result_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output/algorithm_results"
srb_final_file <- file.path(result_dir, "scRhythmBayes_full_final_v2.qs")

benchmark_input <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "benchmark_input.qs"))
res_srb <- qs::qread(srb_final_file)
dry_res <- qs::qread(file.path(result_dir, "dryR_full.qs"))

stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(benchmark_input$counts), as.character(benchmark_input$metadata$cell)),
  setequal(rownames(benchmark_input$counts), res_srb$param_wide$gene),
  setequal(rownames(benchmark_input$counts), rownames(dry_res$results))
)

module_out_dir <- "/path/to/analysis_home/Desktop/Figure3_output/module_FGHI_simple"
dir.create(module_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source("/path/to/scRhythmBayes/R/infer_rhythm_module.R")

module_fit <- infer_rhythm_module(
  param_wide = res_srb$param_wide,
  compare_by = "group",
  group1 = "cond_1",
  group2 = "cond_2",
  Verbose = TRUE
)

module_result <- module_fit$module_result
module_truth <- benchmark_input$gene_meta %>%
  transmute(gene = as.character(gene), truth_module = as.integer(module))

module_dryr <- dry_res$results %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene),
    chosen_model = as.integer(chosen_model),
    chosen_model_BICW = as.numeric(chosen_model_BICW),
    amp_cond_1 = as.numeric(amp_cond_1),
    amp_cond_2 = as.numeric(amp_cond_2),
    phase_cond_1 = as.numeric(phase_cond_1),
    phase_cond_2 = as.numeric(phase_cond_2)
  )

module_input_status <- res_srb$param_wide %>%
  transmute(
    gene,
    input_complete = if_all(
      c(FDR_cond_1, FDR_cond_2, Amplitude_cond_1, Amplitude_cond_2, Phase_cond_1, Phase_cond_2),
      is.finite
    )
  )

module_eval <- module_result %>%
  select(gene, module_map) %>%
  left_join(module_input_status, by = "gene") %>%
  inner_join(module_truth, by = "gene") %>%
  inner_join(module_dryr, by = "gene")

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(module_result$gene),
  !anyDuplicated(module_truth$gene),
  !anyDuplicated(module_dryr$gene),
  setequal(module_result$gene, module_truth$gene),
  nrow(module_eval) == nrow(module_truth),
  all(module_eval$module_map %in% 0:7),
  all(module_eval$truth_module %in% 0:7),
  all(module_eval$chosen_model %in% 1:5)
)

qs::qsave(module_fit, file.path(module_out_dir, "scRhythmBayes_module_fit.qs"))
write_tsv(module_result, file.path(module_out_dir, "scRhythmBayes_module_assignment.tsv"))
write_tsv(module_fit$module_summary, file.path(module_out_dir, "scRhythmBayes_module_summary.tsv"))

module_fit$module_summary
```

这里读入前文保存的模拟数据、SRB 基因参数和 dryR 结果，再用 `res_srb$param_wide` 调用当前 `infer_rhythm_module()`。本节可在新的 R 会话中独立运行。OVR 是另一条基因节律判定分支，不是 module 推断前必须串联的步骤，因此这里不经过 OVR。

## 10.2 Evaluation tables
```{r module-tables}
module_labels <- paste0("M", 0:7)
dryr_labels <- paste0("D", 1:5)

module_colors <- c(M0="#BDBDBD", M1="#E6F3FF", M2="#B8E0FF", M3="#8ACBFF", M4="#5CB8FF", M5="#7A93AC", M6="#008FFF", M7="#0077CC")
truth_colors <- c(M0="#FFFAF0", M1="#FFF7CC", M2="#FFEC99", M3="#FFE066", M4="#FBD833", M5="#FFE866", M6="#FFD666", M7="#FFCC80")
dryr_colors <- c(D1="#FFFBF8", D2="#FBE4D8", D3="#F6BFA6", D4="#EE9B7A", D5="#F59E78")

module_class_key <- tribble(
  ~Class, ~Definition,
  "M0", "non-rhythmic in both conditions",
  "M1", "shared rhythm",
  "M2", "rhythm gained in cond_2",
  "M3", "rhythm lost in cond_2",
  "M4", "amplitude enhanced in cond_2",
  "M5", "amplitude attenuated in cond_2",
  "M6", "phase advanced in cond_2",
  "M7", "phase delayed in cond_2"
)

dryr_model_key <- tribble(
  ~Class, ~Definition,
  "D1", "non-rhythmic in both conditions",
  "D2", "rhythmic in cond_1 only",
  "D3", "rhythmic in cond_2 only",
  "D4", "shared rhythm",
  "D5", "rhythmic in both conditions with different curves"
)

cm_srb_truth <- module_eval %>%
  count(truth_module, module_map, name = "Freq") %>%
  complete(truth_module = 0:7, module_map = 0:7, fill = list(Freq = 0))

cm_srb_dryr <- module_eval %>%
  count(module_map, chosen_model, name = "Freq") %>%
  complete(module_map = 0:7, chosen_model = 1:5, fill = list(Freq = 0))

cm_dryr_truth <- module_eval %>%
  count(truth_module, chosen_model, name = "Freq") %>%
  complete(truth_module = 0:7, chosen_model = 1:5, fill = list(Freq = 0))

module_metrics <- bind_rows(lapply(0:7, function(k) {
  TP <- sum(module_eval$truth_module == k & module_eval$module_map == k)
  FP <- sum(module_eval$truth_module != k & module_eval$module_map == k)
  FN <- sum(module_eval$truth_module == k & module_eval$module_map != k)
  TN <- nrow(module_eval) - TP - FP - FN

  tibble(
    module_num = k,
    module = factor(paste0("M", k), levels = module_labels),
    TP = TP,
    FP = FP,
    FN = FN,
    TN = TN,
    Accuracy = (TP + TN) / nrow(module_eval),
    Precision = TP / (TP + FP),
    Recall = TP / (TP + FN),
    F1 = 2 * TP / (2 * TP + FP + FN)
  )
}))

module_metrics_long <- module_metrics %>%
  select(module, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1) %>%
  pivot_longer(-module, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(Metric, F1 = "F1-score"),
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Accuracy", "Precision", "Recall", "F1-score")),
    Label = sprintf("%.3f", Value)
  )

alluvial_count <- module_eval %>%
  transmute(
    scRhythmBayes = factor(paste0("M", module_map), levels = module_labels),
    Truth = factor(paste0("M", truth_module), levels = module_labels),
    dryR = factor(paste0("D", chosen_model), levels = dryr_labels)
  ) %>%
  count(scRhythmBayes, Truth, dryR, name = "freq")

alluvial_lodes <- ggforce::gather_set_data(alluvial_count, 1:3) %>%
  mutate(
    x = factor(x, levels = c("scRhythmBayes", "Truth", "dryR")),
    y = factor(as.character(y), levels = c(paste0("M", 7:0), paste0("D", 5:1))),
    fill_key = case_when(
      x == "scRhythmBayes" ~ paste0("SC_", y),
      x == "Truth" ~ paste0("TR_", y),
      TRUE ~ paste0("DR_", y)
    )
  )

module_key_counts <- bind_rows(
  module_truth %>% count(truth_module, name = "n") %>% transmute(Source = "Truth", Class = paste0("M", truth_module), n),
  module_result %>% count(module_map, name = "n") %>% transmute(Source = "scRhythmBayes", Class = paste0("M", module_map), n),
  module_dryr %>% count(chosen_model, name = "n") %>% transmute(Source = "dryR", Class = paste0("D", chosen_model), n)
)

truth_size_check <- module_truth %>% count(truth_module, name = "n")
cm_mat <- xtabs(Freq ~ truth_module + module_map, cm_srb_truth)
metric_check <- tibble(
  module_num = 0:7,
  TP = diag(cm_mat),
  FP = colSums(cm_mat) - diag(cm_mat),
  FN = rowSums(cm_mat) - diag(cm_mat),
  TN = sum(cm_mat) - TP - FP - FN
)

module_checks <- tibble(
  Check = c("module genes", "truth genes", "dryR genes", "truth modules with 500 genes", "SRB input rows accounted", "SRB-Truth confusion sum", "SRB-dryR confusion sum", "dryR-Truth confusion sum", "alluvial sum", "metric count identity"),
  Observed = c(nrow(module_result), nrow(module_truth), nrow(module_dryr), sum(truth_size_check$n == 500), nrow(module_input_status), sum(cm_srb_truth$Freq), sum(cm_srb_dryr$Freq), sum(cm_dryr_truth$Freq), sum(alluvial_count$freq), sum(module_metrics[c("TP","FP","FN","TN")] == metric_check[c("TP","FP","FN","TN")])),
  Expected = c(nrow(module_truth), nrow(module_truth), nrow(module_truth), 8, nrow(module_truth), nrow(module_eval), nrow(module_eval), nrow(module_eval), nrow(module_eval), 32)
) %>%
  mutate(Pass = Observed == Expected)

write_tsv(module_class_key, file.path(module_out_dir, "scRhythmBayes_module_key.tsv"))
write_tsv(dryr_model_key, file.path(module_out_dir, "dryR_model_key.tsv"))
write_tsv(module_eval, file.path(module_out_dir, "module_complete_evaluation.tsv"))
write_tsv(module_key_counts, file.path(module_out_dir, "module_key_counts.tsv"))
write_tsv(module_input_status, file.path(module_out_dir, "scRhythmBayes_module_input_status.tsv"))
write_tsv(module_metrics, file.path(module_out_dir, "Figure3I_module_metrics.tsv"))
write_tsv(module_metrics_long, file.path(module_out_dir, "Figure3I_module_metrics_long.tsv"))
write_tsv(alluvial_count, file.path(module_out_dir, "Figure3G_alluvial_counts.tsv"))
write_tsv(alluvial_lodes, file.path(module_out_dir, "Figure3G_alluvial_lodes.tsv"))
write_tsv(cm_srb_truth, file.path(module_out_dir, "Figure3H_scRhythmBayes_vs_Truth.tsv"))
write_tsv(cm_srb_dryr, file.path(module_out_dir, "Figure3H_scRhythmBayes_vs_dryR.tsv"))
write_tsv(cm_dryr_truth, file.path(module_out_dir, "Figure3H_dryR_vs_Truth.tsv"))
write_tsv(module_checks, file.path(module_out_dir, "module_consistency_checks.tsv"))

print(module_key_counts)
print(module_metrics)
print(module_checks)
stopifnot(all(module_checks$Pass))
```

## 10.3 Figure F heatmaps
```{r module-figure-f}
source("/path/to/scRhythmBayes/reproducibility/support/legacy/simHeatmap5.R")

expr.matrix <- benchmark_input$counts
meta.module <- benchmark_input$metadata
stopifnot(identical(colnames(expr.matrix), meta.module$cell))

cell.phase <- meta.module$theta_true
group.vec <- meta.module$group
pair_levels <- c("cond_1", "cond_2")

gene.module.vec <- setNames(module_result$module_map, module_result$gene)
gene.phase.cond_1 <- setNames(res_srb$param_wide$Phase_cond_1, res_srb$param_wide$gene)
gene.phase.cond_2 <- setNames(res_srb$param_wide$Phase_cond_2, res_srb$param_wide$gene)

genes_use <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(expr.matrix), names(gene.module.vec), names(gene.phase.cond_1), names(gene.phase.cond_2)))
expr.srb <- expr.matrix[genes_use, , drop = FALSE]
gene.module.vec <- gene.module.vec[genes_use]
gene.phase.cond_1 <- gene.phase.cond_1[genes_use]
gene.phase.cond_2 <- gene.phase.cond_2[genes_use]

srb_heatmap_files <- vector("list", 8)
srb_heatmap_order <- vector("list", 8)

for (m in 0:7) {
  ht_srb <- CircadianPairedHeatmapByModule(
    expr.matrix = expr.srb,
    cell.phase = cell.phase,
    gene.module = gene.module.vec,
    module_id = m,
    group.vec = group.vec,
    group_levels = pair_levels,
    gene.phase.cond_1 = gene.phase.cond_1,
    gene.phase.cond_2 = gene.phase.cond_2,
    sort_by = "auto",
    heatmap.pal = "RdYlBu",
    phase.style = "bw6",
    title = paste0("scRhythmBayes M", m, ": cond_1 vs cond_2"),
    use.raster = TRUE,
    raster.quality = 4,
    draw.separators = FALSE,
    zscore_rows = TRUE,
    clip_z = 2
  )

  ht_srb$heatmap@ht_list[[1]]@column_title <- paste0("M", m, " | cond_1")
  ht_srb$heatmap@ht_list[[2]]@column_title <- paste0("M", m, " | cond_2")
  ht_srb$heatmap@ht_list[[1]]@column_title_param$gp <- grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 25, fontface = "bold")
  ht_srb$heatmap@ht_list[[2]]@column_title_param$gp <- grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 25, fontface = "bold")

  pdf_file <- file.path(module_out_dir, paste0("Figure3F_scRhythmBayes_M", m, ".pdf"))
  png_file <- file.path(module_out_dir, paste0("Figure3F_scRhythmBayes_M", m, ".png"))
  qs_file <- file.path(module_out_dir, paste0("Figure3F_scRhythmBayes_M", m, "_source.qs"))

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(pdf_file, width = 10, height = 7, family = "Arial")
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial")))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_srb$heatmap, merge_legends = TRUE, column_title = ht_srb$title, column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 28, fontface = "bold"), newpage = FALSE)
  grid::popViewport()
  grDevices::dev.off()

  ragg::agg_png(png_file, width = 10, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial")))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_srb$heatmap, merge_legends = TRUE, column_title = ht_srb$title, column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 28, fontface = "bold"), newpage = FALSE)
  grid::popViewport()
  grDevices::dev.off()

  qs::qsave(list(matrix_cond_1 = ht_srb$matrix_left, matrix_cond_2 = ht_srb$matrix_right, row_order = ht_srb$row_order, sort_by = ht_srb$sort_by_use), qs_file)
  srb_heatmap_order[[m + 1]] <- tibble(Method = "scRhythmBayes", Class = paste0("M", m), Gene = ht_srb$row_order, Rank = seq_along(ht_srb$row_order), Sort_by = ht_srb$sort_by_use)
  srb_heatmap_files[[m + 1]] <- tibble(Panel = "F", Method = "scRhythmBayes", Class = paste0("M", m), PNG = png_file, PDF = pdf_file, Source = qs_file)
}

gene.model.vec <- setNames(module_dryr$chosen_model, module_dryr$gene)
gene.phase.cond_1 <- setNames(module_dryr$phase_cond_1, module_dryr$gene)
gene.phase.cond_2 <- setNames(module_dryr$phase_cond_2, module_dryr$gene)

genes_use <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(expr.matrix), names(gene.model.vec), names(gene.phase.cond_1), names(gene.phase.cond_2)))
expr.dryr <- expr.matrix[genes_use, , drop = FALSE]
gene.model.vec <- gene.model.vec[genes_use]
gene.phase.cond_1 <- gene.phase.cond_1[genes_use]
gene.phase.cond_2 <- gene.phase.cond_2[genes_use]
dry_sort_map <- c("cond_1", "cond_1", "cond_2", "cond_1", "cond_1")

dryr_heatmap_files <- vector("list", 5)
dryr_heatmap_order <- vector("list", 5)

for (m in 1:5) {
  ht_dryr <- CircadianPairedHeatmapByModule(
    expr.matrix = expr.dryr,
    cell.phase = cell.phase,
    gene.module = gene.model.vec,
    module_id = m,
    group.vec = group.vec,
    group_levels = pair_levels,
    gene.phase.cond_1 = gene.phase.cond_1,
    gene.phase.cond_2 = gene.phase.cond_2,
    sort_by = dry_sort_map[m],
    heatmap.pal = "RdYlBu",
    phase.style = "bw6",
    title = paste0("dryR D", m, ": cond_1 vs cond_2"),
    use.raster = TRUE,
    raster.quality = 4,
    draw.separators = FALSE,
    zscore_rows = TRUE,
    clip_z = 2
  )

  ht_dryr$heatmap@ht_list[[1]]@column_title <- paste0("D", m, " | cond_1")
  ht_dryr$heatmap@ht_list[[2]]@column_title <- paste0("D", m, " | cond_2")
  ht_dryr$heatmap@ht_list[[1]]@column_title_param$gp <- grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 25, fontface = "bold")
  ht_dryr$heatmap@ht_list[[2]]@column_title_param$gp <- grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 25, fontface = "bold")

  pdf_file <- file.path(module_out_dir, paste0("Figure3F_dryR_D", m, ".pdf"))
  png_file <- file.path(module_out_dir, paste0("Figure3F_dryR_D", m, ".png"))
  qs_file <- file.path(module_out_dir, paste0("Figure3F_dryR_D", m, "_source.qs"))

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(pdf_file, width = 10, height = 7, family = "Arial")
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial")))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_dryr$heatmap, merge_legends = TRUE, column_title = ht_dryr$title, column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 28, fontface = "bold"), newpage = FALSE)
  grid::popViewport()
  grDevices::dev.off()

  ragg::agg_png(png_file, width = 10, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
  grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial")))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_dryr$heatmap, merge_legends = TRUE, column_title = ht_dryr$title, column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "Arial", fontsize = 28, fontface = "bold"), newpage = FALSE)
  grid::popViewport()
  grDevices::dev.off()

  qs::qsave(list(matrix_cond_1 = ht_dryr$matrix_left, matrix_cond_2 = ht_dryr$matrix_right, row_order = ht_dryr$row_order, sort_by = ht_dryr$sort_by_use), qs_file)
  dryr_heatmap_order[[m]] <- tibble(Method = "dryR", Class = paste0("D", m), Gene = ht_dryr$row_order, Rank = seq_along(ht_dryr$row_order), Sort_by = ht_dryr$sort_by_use)
  dryr_heatmap_files[[m]] <- tibble(Panel = "F", Method = "dryR", Class = paste0("D", m), PNG = png_file, PDF = pdf_file, Source = qs_file)
}

figure_f_order <- bind_rows(bind_rows(srb_heatmap_order), bind_rows(dryr_heatmap_order))
figure_f_files <- bind_rows(bind_rows(srb_heatmap_files), bind_rows(dryr_heatmap_files))

write_tsv(figure_f_order, file.path(module_out_dir, "Figure3F_heatmap_gene_order.tsv"))
write_tsv(figure_f_files, file.path(module_out_dir, "Figure3F_heatmap_files.tsv"))

print(figure_f_files)
```

Figure F 这里只输出独立热图，不生成模块示意曲线，也不替你拼接总图。细胞按完整真值相位 `theta_true` 排序，与旧版 Figure F 热图代码一致；行顺序由各方法自己的估计相位决定。

```{r module-figure-g}
module_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 17, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial", colour = "#20242A"),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "bold", size = 28, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.tag = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "bold", size = 28),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "bold", size = 20),

    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

node_colors <- c(
  setNames(module_colors, paste0("SC_", names(module_colors))),
  setNames(truth_colors, paste0("TR_", names(truth_colors))),
  setNames(dryr_colors, paste0("DR_", names(dryr_colors)))
)
```
